```text
# EPD² API-01 — authoritative acceptance workflow (C5).
#
# The run that judges a candidate is never the run that built it. This workflow
# verifies ONE sealed cumulative archive against THREE external anchors, all four
# obtained by exact filename and SHA-256 before anything is read:
#
#   candidate                  EPD2_API01_PRODUCTION_API_GATEWAY_AND_BFF_BOUNDARIES_CANDIDATE_0.1_C5.zip
#                              (expected digest = workflow input; must differ from every anchor)
#   API01_REJECTED_C4_ZIP      …_CANDIDATE_0.1_C4.zip  0e5a8310…  (rejected C4, correction predecessor;
#                              the exact bytes exercised by authoritative run 32948753708)
#   API01_REJECTED_C2_ZIP      …_CANDIDATE_0.1_C2.zip  80c02d6d…  (rejected C2, history; repository
#                              Master before reconciliation for MASTER_REGISTER_CONSISTENCY)
#   API01_ACCEPTED_DATA06_ZIP  EPD2_DATA_SERIES_CANONICAL_BASELINE_0.1_FINAL.zip  8cba0199…
#                              (sole acceptance predecessor)
#
# C5 correction. Authoritative run 32948753708 on the exact C4 bytes reached the
# complete validator and failed only on `FAIL 15: no gate environment-blocked — 13`
# (gate 13 = NOT_RUN_ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED): browser provisioning was fail-open
# (`playwright install chromium >/dev/null 2>&1 || true`) and the executable was
# guessed from `~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-*/chrome-linux/chrome`, a layout
# Playwright 1.62.0 does not produce (it installs `chromium-<build>/chrome-linux64/
# chrome`). Step 17 below installs the frozen Playwright without suppressing
# failure, resolves the executable mechanically through `chromium.executablePath()`,
# proves it exists, is a regular file, is executable and runs, and only then
# publishes the canonical path — and fails immediately if any of that fails.
# Nothing else about API-01 changed and gate 13 was NOT weakened.
#
# There is no "overlay" mode and no "repository" mode (C1 finding F-02): the
# candidate is the complete tree; the checked-out repository contributes only
# GITHUB_SHA as provenance and may never substitute a candidate file. The 28
# steps below run in this order; every gate (0-17) runs inside the freshly
# extracted candidate. The sealed-candidate accounting (Layer A exact
# C4→C5 transition inventory + Layer B sealed file manifest, evidence included) is
# verified against the tree AS EXTRACTED before any evidence is regenerated
# (C3 F-03/F-04); the Program Control Register reconciliation state is a semantic
# gate (C3 F-01/F-02); the evidence this run publishes is this run's own
# (current-run C5 evidence) — the candidate-supplied evidence is kept separately
# and labelled as candidate-supplied, never as this run's result.
#
# Toolchain phases are separate and exact (assignment §17):
#   gateway              CPython 3.13.7 from the universal root uv.lock in a separate
#                        frozen environment (the accepted hygiene contract forbids a
#                        nested lock; see docs/api/API-01/API01_C1_TO_C2_CORRECTION_REPORT.md)
#   inherited regression CPython 3.12.12, uv 0.12.5, root uv.lock, PostgreSQL 16.15
#                        built from the upstream source tarball (server_version "16.15"
#                        exactly, as the accepted DATA-06 tests require), Node 22.16.0,
#                        npm 10.9.2
# A missing exact toolchain makes the corresponding gate NOT_RUN_ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED;
# the workflow then fails — it never substitutes (no PostgreSQL 16.9, no vendor build, no other Node).
#
# A local validator run is evidence; only this workflow's PASS on the exact bytes
# is acceptance. NOT PRODUCTION READY. NOT LEGALLY ACTIVATED. NOT A BINDING VOTE.

name: api01-accept

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_sha256:
        description: expected SHA-256 of EPD2_API01_PRODUCTION_API_GATEWAY_AND_BFF_BOUNDARIES_CANDIDATE_0.1_C5.zip
        required: true
      candidate_run_id:
        description: run id whose artifact `api01-candidate` carries the C5 ZIP (empty = candidates/ in the checkout)
        required: false
        default: ""
      anchors_run_id:
        description: run id whose artifact `api01-anchors` carries the three anchor ZIPs (empty = anchors/ in the checkout)
        required: false
        default: ""

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: api01-accept-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  C5_NAME: EPD2_API01_PRODUCTION_API_GATEWAY_AND_BFF_BOUNDARIES_CANDIDATE_0.1_C5
  C4_NAME: EPD2_API01_PRODUCTION_API_GATEWAY_AND_BFF_BOUNDARIES_CANDIDATE_0.1_C4.zip
  C4_SHA256: 0e5a8310f80799778ddcc52b47b58c60afa55b945d9592b1ddd63fff6d067e72
  C2_NAME: EPD2_API01_PRODUCTION_API_GATEWAY_AND_BFF_BOUNDARIES_CANDIDATE_0.1_C2.zip
  C2_SHA256: 80c02d6de378a8166acc5d581397e2016068f5c07c2ac748d7e0e37565a9c61f
  DATA06_NAME: EPD2_DATA_SERIES_CANONICAL_BASELINE_0.1_FINAL.zip
  DATA06_SHA256: 8cba01997e4943f6d3c2b3fc1fe11e2c3527cd6c39123171a827fb8e3669cbf1
  # the frozen browser contract of the governed root package-lock.json
  PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION: "1.62.0"
  CANONICAL_CHROMIUM: /opt/pw-browsers/chromium

jobs:
  accept:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
      UV_FROZEN: "1"
      UV_NO_SYNC_PROGRESS: "1"
    steps:
      # ---------------------------------------------------------------- inputs --
      - name: "01 Check out repository (provenance only — GITHUB_SHA is recorded, nothing is read from it)"
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: "02 Obtain the candidate archive"
        if: ${{ inputs.candidate_run_id != '' }}
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: api01-candidate
          path: incoming/candidate
          run-id: ${{ inputs.candidate_run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: "03 Obtain the anchor archives"
        if: ${{ inputs.anchors_run_id != '' }}
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: api01-anchors
          path: incoming/anchors
          run-id: ${{ inputs.anchors_run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: "04 Locate inputs by exact filename and verify every digest before anything is read"
        id: inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          find_one() {  # $1 = filename, $2 = search roots
            local found; found="$(find $2 -type f -name "$1" 2>/dev/null | head -n 2)"
            [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$found" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 ] || { echo "::error::$1: expected exactly one file, found: $found"; exit 1; }
            printf '%s' "$found"
          }
          C5="$(find_one "${C5_NAME}.zip" "incoming/candidate candidates")"
          C4="$(find_one "${C4_NAME}" "incoming/anchors anchors")"
          C2="$(find_one "${C2_NAME}" "incoming/anchors anchors")"
          D6="$(find_one "${DATA06_NAME}" "incoming/anchors anchors")"
          echo "${{ inputs.candidate_sha256 }}  $C5" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "${C4_SHA256}  $C4" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "${C2_SHA256}  $C2" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "${DATA06_SHA256}  $D6" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "c5=$(realpath "$C5")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "c4=$(realpath "$C4")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "c2=$(realpath "$C2")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "d6=$(realpath "$D6")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: "05 Refuse a relabelled anchor as the candidate (the C5 bytes must be new bytes)"
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for a in "${C4_SHA256}" "${C2_SHA256}" "${DATA06_SHA256}"; do
            [ "${{ inputs.candidate_sha256 }}" != "$a" ] || { echo "::error::candidate digest equals an anchor digest"; exit 1; }
          done
          echo "candidate digest is distinct from every anchor"

      - name: "06 Extract the sealed candidate (single root, safe paths, CRC) and restore modes"
        id: extract
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p work && cd work
          python3 - "${{ steps.inputs.outputs.c5 }}" "${C5_NAME}" <<'PY'
          import sys, zipfile, pathlib
          zf = zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]); root = sys.argv[2]
          names = zf.namelist()
          assert {n.split("/", 1)[0] for n in names} == {root}, "exactly one root required"
          assert all(not n.startswith("/") and ".." not in n.split("/") for n in names), "unsafe path"
          assert zf.testzip() is None, "CRC failure"
          zf.extractall(".")
          for info in zf.infolist():
              if (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0o111:
                  pathlib.Path(info.filename).chmod(0o755)
          PY
          echo "root=$(pwd)/${C5_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: "07 Verify SHA256SUMS.txt (every file except itself and the sealed manifest)"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sha256sum --quiet -c SHA256SUMS.txt
          n_listed=$(grep -c . SHA256SUMS.txt)
          n_files=$(find . -type f ! -path ./SHA256SUMS.txt ! -path ./docs/api/API-01/API01_C5_SEALED_FILE_MANIFEST.json | wc -l)
          [ "$n_listed" = "$n_files" ] || { echo "::error::SHA256SUMS.txt lists $n_listed files, tree has $n_files"; exit 1; }

      - name: "08 Verify the sealed-candidate accounting against the tree AS EXTRACTED (before any evidence is regenerated)"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        env:
          API01_REJECTED_C4_ZIP: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.c4 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Layer A (exact C4→C5 transition inventory) + Layer B (sealed file manifest) — stdlib only.
          # Nothing is written inside the tree: the tree must stay exactly as extracted.
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/run-logs"
          python3 scripts/validate_api01.py --accounting-only | tee "${RUNNER_TEMP}/run-logs/accounting.out"
          grep -q '^API01_ACCOUNTING:PASS:' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/run-logs/accounting.out"
          grep -q '"c3_source": "exact C4 archive"' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/run-logs/accounting.out"

      - name: "09 Set aside the candidate-supplied evidence (labelled, never this run's result) and record governance digests"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-supplied-evidence"
          cp -r validation/api01 "${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-supplied-evidence/validation-api01-as-sealed"
          cp VALIDATION.txt "${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-supplied-evidence/"
          echo "CANDIDATE-SUPPLIED developer precheck evidence extracted from the sealed archive; NOT the authoritative run's evidence" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-supplied-evidence/README.txt"
          sha256sum docs/roadmap/EPD2_PROJECT_ENTRYPOINT.md docs/roadmap/EPD2_PROGRAM_CONTROL_REGISTER.md docs/roadmap/EPD2_MASTER_FUTURE_IMPLEMENTATION_REGISTER.md | tee "${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-supplied-evidence/governance_digests.txt"

      # ------------------------------------------------------------- toolchain --
      - name: "10 Install uv 0.12.5 (root universal lock)"
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          version: "0.12.5"
          enable-cache: false

      - name: "11 Install CPython 3.12.12 (inherited regression) and 3.13.7 (gateway)"
        run: |
          uv python install 3.12.12 3.13.7
          uv python list --only-installed

      - name: "12 Install Node 22.16.0 (frozen frontend contract)"
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22.16.0"

      - name: "13 Pin npm 10.9.2 and record the toolchain"
        run: |
          npm install -g npm@10.9.2
          node --version | grep -qx "v22.16.0"
          npm --version | grep -qx "10.9.2"
          uv --version

      - name: "14 Build the exact canonical PostgreSQL 16.15 from the upstream source tarball"
        # The accepted DATA-06 tests require `SHOW server_version` = "16.15" exactly, which
        # distribution and container builds do not report (they append a vendor suffix). The
        # tarball is the pristine upstream release as mirrored in the Ubuntu pool; its digest
        # is pinned here and verified before extraction.
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq build-essential libreadline-dev zlib1g-dev libssl-dev >/dev/null
          curl -fsSL -o /tmp/postgresql-16.15.tar.gz http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/p/postgresql-16/postgresql-16_16.15.orig.tar.gz
          echo "4f200ca23dfb120ff9838f13ce06014aad1d3c432d16ee9f93ab2000c0eeef7b  /tmp/postgresql-16.15.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          mkdir -p /tmp/pgsrc && tar xzf /tmp/postgresql-16.15.tar.gz -C /tmp/pgsrc
          cd /tmp/pgsrc/postgresql-16.15
          ./configure --prefix=/opt/pg1615 --without-icu --with-openssl >/tmp/pg-configure.log
          make -j"$(nproc)" >/tmp/pg-make.log && make install >/tmp/pg-install.log
          (cd contrib/pgcrypto && make -j"$(nproc)" >>/tmp/pg-make.log && make install >>/tmp/pg-install.log)
          /opt/pg1615/bin/postgres --version

      - name: "15 Start the canonical cluster and create the runtime test databases"
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pg1615" && /opt/pg1615/bin/initdb -D "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pg1615/data" --auth=trust -U epd2 >/dev/null && true
          /opt/pg1615/bin/pg_ctl -D "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pg1615/data" -l "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pg1615/pg.log" -o "-p 5432 -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1" -w start
          v="$(/opt/pg1615/bin/psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U epd2 -d postgres -tAc 'show server_version')"
          echo "server_version=$v"
          [ "$v" = "16.15" ] || { echo "::error::PostgreSQL server is '$v', not the accepted exact 16.15 — no substitution"; exit 1; }
          # the accepted pilot scripts require a non-empty database password
          /opt/pg1615/bin/psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U epd2 -d postgres -c "alter user epd2 password 'epd2-ci-only'"
          for db in epd2_test epd2_voting_test; do
            /opt/pg1615/bin/psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U epd2 -d postgres -c "create database $db owner epd2"
          done
          /opt/pg1615/bin/psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U epd2 -d epd2_test -c "create extension if not exists pgcrypto"
          echo "/opt/pg1615/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: "16 Frozen-sync the root universal lock (CPython 3.12.12) outside the tree"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        env:
          UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ runner.temp }}/epd2-api01-root-env
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv sync --frozen --all-groups --python 3.12.12
          uv run --frozen python --version | grep -qx "Python 3.12.12"

      - name: "17 Provision the frozen Chromium fail-closed (C5 correction of authoritative run 32948753708)"
        # The browser is a MANDATORY acceptance dependency of gate 13. Every step below
        # fails the job immediately (`set -euo pipefail`, no `|| true`, no `2>/dev/null`):
        #   1. the frozen Playwright version is read from the governed root package-lock.json
        #      and must equal PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION;
        #   2. that exact Playwright is installed into a provisioning directory outside the
        #      candidate tree (the tree must stay byte-identical to the archive);
        #   3. `playwright install chromium` runs with its failure NOT suppressed;
        #   4. the executable is resolved MECHANICALLY by Playwright itself
        #      (`chromium.executablePath()`) — never by guessing a directory layout;
        #   5. the executable is proven to exist, to be a regular file and to be executable;
        #   6. the canonical path the validator/browser harness expects is established;
        #   7. the canonical path is proven executable and the browser is RUN (--version);
        #   8. a machine-readable provisioning record is written for the run evidence.
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/run-logs"

          # 1. the governed frozen Playwright version (root package-lock.json is the contract)
          LOCKED="$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('package-lock.json'))['packages']['node_modules/@playwright/test']['version'])")"
          echo "package-lock.json @playwright/test = ${LOCKED}; workflow pin = ${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION}"
          [ "${LOCKED}" = "${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION}" ] || { echo "::error::frozen Playwright ${LOCKED} != workflow pin ${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION}"; exit 1; }

          # 2. install that exact Playwright OUTSIDE the candidate tree
          PW_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/playwright-provision"
          rm -rf "${PW_DIR}"; mkdir -p "${PW_DIR}"
          ( cd "${PW_DIR}" && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm install --no-audit --no-fund "playwright@${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION}" )
          INSTALLED="$(node -e "console.log(require('${PW_DIR}/node_modules/playwright/package.json').version)")"
          [ "${INSTALLED}" = "${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION}" ] || { echo "::error::installed Playwright ${INSTALLED} != ${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION}"; exit 1; }

          # 3. install the browser — failure is NOT suppressed (the C4 defect)
          "${PW_DIR}/node_modules/.bin/playwright" install chromium

          # 4. resolve the executable mechanically from Playwright itself
          CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE="$(node -e "console.log(require('${PW_DIR}/node_modules/playwright').chromium.executablePath())")"
          echo "resolved chromium executable: ${CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE}"

          # 5. prove it exists, is a regular file and is executable
          test -n "${CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE}"
          test -f "${CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE}"
          test -x "${CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE}"

          # 6. establish the canonical path the validator and playwright.config.ts expect
          sudo mkdir -p "$(dirname "${CANONICAL_CHROMIUM}")"
          sudo ln -sfn "${CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE}" "${CANONICAL_CHROMIUM}"

          # 7. prove the canonical path is executable and RUN the browser
          test -x "${CANONICAL_CHROMIUM}"
          CHROMIUM_VERSION="$("${CANONICAL_CHROMIUM}" --version)"
          echo "canonical chromium: ${CANONICAL_CHROMIUM} -> $(readlink -f "${CANONICAL_CHROMIUM}") (${CHROMIUM_VERSION})"

          # 8. machine-readable provisioning record for this run's evidence
          python3 - "${PW_DIR}" "${CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE}" "${CHROMIUM_VERSION}" "${LOCKED}" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/run-logs/browser_provisioning.json" <<'PY'
          import json, os, sys, subprocess
          pw_dir, executable, version, locked = sys.argv[1:5]
          canonical = os.environ["CANONICAL_CHROMIUM"]
          cli = subprocess.run([f"{pw_dir}/node_modules/.bin/playwright", "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True)
          json.dump({
              "step": "17 browser provisioning (fail-closed)",
              "corrects": {"authoritative_run": "32948753708", "gate": "13", "classification": "ENVIRONMENT_PROVISIONING"},
              "playwright_frozen_version_package_lock": locked,
              "playwright_workflow_pin": os.environ["PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION"],
              "playwright_cli_version": cli.stdout.strip(),
              "resolution_method": "require('playwright').chromium.executablePath()",
              "resolved_chromium_executable": executable,
              "resolved_exists": os.path.isfile(executable),
              "resolved_executable_bit": os.access(executable, os.X_OK),
              "canonical_chromium_path": canonical,
              "canonical_target": os.path.realpath(canonical),
              "canonical_executable_bit": os.access(canonical, os.X_OK),
              "chromium_version": version,
              "fail_open_suppression_used": False,
              "github_run_id": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
          }, sys.stdout, indent=2)
          PY
          cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/run-logs/browser_provisioning.json"

      # ------------------------------------------------------------ validation --
      - name: "18 Run the C5 validator inside the extracted candidate (gates 0-17, all phases, exact C5 bytes)"
        id: validate
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        env:
          API01_REJECTED_C4_ZIP: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.c4 }}
          API01_REJECTED_C2_ZIP: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.c2 }}
          API01_ACCEPTED_DATA06_ZIP: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.d6 }}
          API01_BROWSER_PROVISIONING_JSON: ${{ runner.temp }}/run-logs/browser_provisioning.json
          EPD2_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://epd2:epd2-ci-only@127.0.0.1:5432/epd2_test
          EPD2_VOTING_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://epd2:epd2-ci-only@127.0.0.1:5432/epd2_voting_test
          DATA06_PG_BINDIR: /opt/pg1615/bin
          DATA06_WORKDIR: /tmp/d6w # short: the DATA-06 executor tests bind Unix sockets (107-byte path limit)
          EPD2_LOCAL_CI_HOME: ${{ runner.temp }}/epd2-local-ci-api01
          UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ runner.temp }}/epd2-api01-root-env
          API01_GATEWAY_ENV: ${{ runner.temp }}/epd2-api01-gateway-env
          API01_SCRATCH: ${{ runner.temp }}/epd2-api01-scratch
          EPD2_CHROMIUM: /opt/pw-browsers/chromium
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "${DATA06_WORKDIR}"
          uv run --frozen python scripts/validate_api01.py \
            --candidate-zip "${{ steps.inputs.outputs.c5 }}" | tee "${RUNNER_TEMP}/run-logs/validator.out"
          grep -q '^API01_RESULT:PASS:' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/run-logs/validator.out"

      - name: "19 Assert the sealed-accounting gate passed in the validator's own run (gate 1 from the archive bytes, gate 4 as extracted)"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          r = json.load(open("validation/api01/final_validator_result.json"))
          g = {x["gate"]: x for x in r["gates"]}
          assert g["1"]["result"] == "PASS" and g["4"]["result"] == "PASS", (g["1"]["result"], g["4"]["result"])
          m = json.load(open("validation/api01/sealed_manifest_result.json"))
          assert m["sealed_accounting_present"] is True and m.get("c3_source") == "exact C4 archive" and not m.get("problems"), m
          print("sealed accounting: Layer A", m.get("transition_inventory_counts"), "Layer B", m.get("sealed_manifest_counts"))
          PY

      - name: "20 Assert the Program Control Register reconciliation state gate (semantic, fail-closed)"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          p = json.load(open("validation/api01/program_control_reconciliation_result.json"))
          assert p["program_control_reconciliation"] == "PASS" and p["register_state_read"] == "COMPLETE", p
          assert p["record"]["reconciliation_state_after"] == "COMPLETE/CURRENT" and p["record"]["stage_state_changes"] == "none"
          m = json.load(open("validation/api01/master_reconciliation_result.json"))
          assert m["master_register_consistency"] == "PASS", m["problems"]
          print("PCR reconciliation state COMPLETE/CURRENT; Master consistency PASS")
          PY

      - name: "21 Assert the browser environment and the fail-closed provisioning (C5 correction of gate 13)"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        env:
          API01_BROWSER_PROVISIONING_JSON: ${{ runner.temp }}/run-logs/browser_provisioning.json
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          b = json.load(open("validation/api01/browser_environment_result.json"))
          assert b["gate_result"] == "PASS", b["gate_result"]
          assert not b["problems"] and not b["workflow_provisioning_problems"], b
          assert b["exists"] and b["is_regular_file"] and b["executable"], b
          assert b["playwright_frozen_version"] == os.environ["PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION"], b["playwright_frozen_version"]
          assert b["chromium_version"], "the browser did not report a version"
          rec = b["workflow_provisioning_record"]
          assert rec and rec["fail_open_suppression_used"] is False and rec["resolution_method"].endswith("executablePath()"), rec
          assert rec["canonical_chromium_path"] == b["canonical_chromium_path"] == os.environ["CANONICAL_CHROMIUM"]
          g = {x["gate"]: x for x in json.load(open("validation/api01/final_validator_result.json"))["gates"]}
          assert g["13"]["result"] == "PASS", g["13"]
          print("browser:", b["chromium_version"], "->", b["resolved_chromium_executable"])
          PY

      - name: "22 Assert inherited-regression semantics (no new regression against the accepted DATA-06 baseline)"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          pg = json.load(open("validation/api01/postgresql_result.json"))
          assert pg["result_semantics"] == "NO_NEW_REGRESSION_AGAINST_ACCEPTED_DATA06_BASELINE", pg["result_semantics"]
          assert pg["new_failures"] == [], pg["new_failures"]
          assert pg["phase_b"]["postgresql_server_version"] == "16.15"
          print("phase B:", pg["phase_b"].get("tail"), "new_failures = 0")
          PY

      - name: "23 Assert route truth is derived from the runtime source (no hard-coded count)"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          inv = json.load(open("contracts/api/api01-runtime-inventory.json"))
          reg = json.load(open("contracts/api/api01-route-registry.json"))
          s = json.load(open("validation/api01/route_inventory_result.json"))["summary"]
          ri = s["runtime_inventory"]
          assert ri["result"] == "PASS" and ri["runtime_only"] == [] and ri["registry_only"] == [] and ri["committed_inventory_current"], ri
          n_runtime = inv["total_routes"]  # derived by AST from the runtime source, re-derived by gate 5
          assert n_runtime == ri["total_runtime_routes"] == ri["registry_routes"] == reg["counts"]["total"] == s["total"], (n_runtime, ri, s["total"])
          print("routes derived from the runtime source:", n_runtime)
          PY

      - name: "24 Assert the mutation suite (M01-M28, at least 28 fixtures, every one detected)"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          st = json.load(open("validation/api01/validator_mutation_result.json"))
          fx = st["fixtures"]
          assert len(fx) >= 28 and all(f["result"] == "PASS" for f in fx), [f["fixture"] for f in fx if f["result"] != "PASS"]
          ids = {f["fixture"] for f in fx}
          assert {"M20", "M21", "M22", "M23", "M24", "M25", "M26", "M27", "M28"} <= ids, ids
          print(len(fx), "fixtures detected")
          PY

      - name: "25 Refuse any self-issued acceptance wording in the candidate"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, re
          r = json.load(open("validation/api01/final_validator_result.json"))
          assert r["acceptance_state"] == "LOCAL_PRECHECK_PASS_CANDIDATE_NOT_ACCEPTED", r["acceptance_state"]
          assert r["authoritative"] is False
          lin = json.load(open("docs/api/API-01/API01_LINEAGE.json"))
          assert lin["acceptance_state"] == "CANDIDATE_NOT_ACCEPTED"
          assert lin["candidate"]["role"] == "C5" and lin["correction_predecessor"]["sha256"] == "0e5a8310f80799778ddcc52b47b58c60afa55b945d9592b1ddd63fff6d067e72"
          run = lin["correction_predecessor"]["authoritative_run"]
          assert run["run_id"] == "32948753708" and run["result"] == "FAILURE" and run["failure_gate"] == "13"
          assert run["classification"] == "ENVIRONMENT_PROVISIONING" and run["new_api_regression"] is False
          text = open("docs/api/API-01/01_EXECUTIVE_RESULT.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
          for pat in (r"API-01\s*=\s*ACCEPTED", r"\bFINAL PASS\b", r"\bAPI-02 authorized\b"):
              assert not re.search(pat, text), pat
          print("no self-issued acceptance claim")
          PY

      - name: "26 Assert the published evidence is this run's own (current-run C5 evidence, not relabelled)"
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          env = json.load(open("validation/api01/environment.json"))
          assert env["github_actions"] is True and env["github_run_id"] == os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"], env.get("github_run_id")
          assert env["candidate_root"].endswith("_C5") and env["expected_candidate"]["version"] == "0.1_C5"
          print("evidence written by run", env["github_run_id"], "on", env["github_sha"])
          PY

      - name: "27 Publish evidence (this run's evidence is the authoritative record; candidate-supplied evidence separately labelled)"
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: api01-c5-acceptance-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}/validation/api01/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/run-logs/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/candidate-supplied-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

      - name: "28 Result"
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "API-01 C5 acceptance run ${GITHUB_RUN_ID} on ${GITHUB_SHA} (provenance)"
          echo "candidate sha256 ${{ inputs.candidate_sha256 }}"
          echo "outcome: ${{ steps.validate.outcome }} — only PASS here is acceptance; the candidate itself remains CANDIDATE_NOT_ACCEPTED until the register maintainer records this run."

```text
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify repository skeleton
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install Python dependencies (frozen — must match uv.lock exactly)
        run: uv sync --all-groups --frozen

      - name: Install Node dependencies (reproducible — must match package-lock.json exactly)
        run: npm ci

      - name: Fail if lock files were modified by install
        run: git diff --exit-code -- uv.lock package-lock.json

      - name: Repository structure check
        run: |
          uv run python scripts/check_repository.py
          uv run python scripts/check_forbidden_files.py
          uv run python scripts/verify_versions.py

      - name: Formatting check (Python)
        run: uv run ruff format --check .

      - name: Formatting check (Prettier)
        run: npm run format:check

      - name: Lint (Python)
        run: uv run ruff check .

      - name: Type check (collision-safe repository command)
        run: make typecheck

      - name: Python tests
        run: uv run pytest

      - name: Type check (TypeScript — epd2-types)
        run: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/typescript/epd2-types

      - name: Type check (TypeScript — web-shell)
        run: npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend/web-shell

      - name: Lint (frontend)
        run: npm run lint --workspace=frontend/web-shell

      - name: TypeScript tests
        run: npm run test --workspace=packages/typescript/epd2-types

      - name: Frontend tests
        run: npm run test --workspace=frontend/web-shell

      - name: Frontend build
        run: npm run build --workspace=frontend/web-shell

      - name: Browser, accessibility, and visual regression tests
        run: npm run test:browser --workspace=frontend/web-shell

# This workflow does not use any repository secrets, does not deploy
# anything, and does not publish any package. It only verifies the
# repository skeleton.

```

```text
name: EPD2 Handoff Intake

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      stage:
        description: "Governed block label, e.g. API-02 or FINAL-INTEGRATION"
        required: true
        type: string
      source_ref:
        description: "Transport branch, e.g. handoff/api-02"
        required: true
        type: string
      candidate_path:
        description: "Exact repository path to the sealed candidate ZIP"
        required: true
        type: string
      expected_sha256:
        description: "Expected SHA-256; leave empty only if not yet independently supplied"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      expected_size:
        description: "Expected byte size; leave empty only if not yet independently supplied"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  intake:
    name: Exact-byte transport verification
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout transport branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref }}
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Verify candidate bytes and generate intake metadata
        id: verify
        shell: bash
        env:
          EPD2_STAGE: ${{ inputs.stage }}
          EPD2_SOURCE_REF: ${{ inputs.source_ref }}
          EPD2_CANDIDATE_PATH: ${{ inputs.candidate_path }}
          EPD2_EXPECTED_SHA256: ${{ inputs.expected_sha256 }}
          EPD2_EXPECTED_SIZE: ${{ inputs.expected_size }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          candidate="$EPD2_CANDIDATE_PATH"
          test -f "$candidate" || { echo "candidate not found: $candidate" >&2; exit 20; }

          actual_sha256="$(sha256sum "$candidate" | awk '{print $1}')"
          actual_size="$(stat -c '%s' "$candidate")"

          if [[ -n "$EPD2_EXPECTED_SHA256" && "$actual_sha256" != "$EPD2_EXPECTED_SHA256" ]]; then
            echo "SHA-256 mismatch" >&2
            echo "expected=$EPD2_EXPECTED_SHA256" >&2
            echo "actual=$actual_sha256" >&2
            exit 21
          fi

          if [[ -n "$EPD2_EXPECTED_SIZE" && "$actual_size" != "$EPD2_EXPECTED_SIZE" ]]; then
            echo "size mismatch" >&2
            echo "expected=$EPD2_EXPECTED_SIZE" >&2
            echo "actual=$actual_size" >&2
            exit 22
          fi

          mkdir -p _handoff_out
          cp -- "$candidate" "_handoff_out/$(basename "$candidate")"

          export EPD2_ACTUAL_SHA256="$actual_sha256"
          export EPD2_ACTUAL_SIZE="$actual_size"
          export EPD2_HEAD_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          export EPD2_FILE_NAME="$(basename "$candidate")"
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          payload = {
              "schema": "epd2.github-handoff-intake/1",
              "state": "EXACT_BYTES_TRANSPORTED",
              "stage": os.environ["EPD2_STAGE"],
              "source_ref": os.environ["EPD2_SOURCE_REF"],
              "source_head_sha": os.environ["EPD2_HEAD_SHA"],
              "candidate_path": os.environ["EPD2_CANDIDATE_PATH"],
              "candidate_filename": os.environ["EPD2_FILE_NAME"],
              "sha256": os.environ["EPD2_ACTUAL_SHA256"],
              "size_bytes": int(os.environ["EPD2_ACTUAL_SIZE"]),
              "expected_sha256_supplied": bool(os.environ.get("EPD2_EXPECTED_SHA256")),
              "expected_size_supplied": bool(os.environ.get("EPD2_EXPECTED_SIZE")),
              "acceptance": "NOT_PERFORMED",
              "note": "Transport verification only; this record is not acceptance evidence."
          }
          with open("_handoff_out/HANDOFF_INTAKE_METADATA.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              json.dump(payload, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
              f.write("\n")
          PY

          echo "sha256=$actual_sha256" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "size=$actual_size" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "EPD2_HANDOFF_EXACT_BYTES_TRANSPORTED stage=$EPD2_STAGE sha256=$actual_sha256 size=$actual_size"

      - name: Upload exact transported bytes
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: epd2-handoff-${{ inputs.stage }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: _handoff_out/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

```

name: front02-governed-review

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: [.github/workflows/front02-governed-review.yml]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source_ref:
        description: Transport branch that contains the sealed ZIP
        required: true
        default: handoff/front
        type: string
      candidate_sha256:
        description: Exact SHA-256 of the sealed candidate
        required: true
        default: aaf980a2cd3b3b06d48218adaa68d109c8770e6abfcbef230197b51a87006179
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  review:
    name: Independent sealed-candidate precheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || 'handoff/front' }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify exact transport bytes before extraction
        id: candidate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          candidate="handoff/FRONT/incoming/EPD2_FRONT02_IMPLEMENTATION_CANDIDATE_0.1_C2.1_2026-08-30.zip"
          expected="${{ inputs.candidate_sha256 || 'aaf980a2cd3b3b06d48218adaa68d109c8770e6abfcbef230197b51a87006179' }}"
          test -f "$candidate"
          echo "$expected  $candidate" | sha256sum -c -
          python3 - "$candidate" "$expected" <<'PY'
          import hashlib, os, sys
          candidate, expected = sys.argv[1:]
          assert os.path.getsize(candidate) > 0
          assert hashlib.sha256(open(candidate, "rb").read()).hexdigest() == expected
          PY
          echo "path=$candidate" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Safely extract the sealed candidate
        id: extract
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - "${{ steps.candidate.outputs.path }}" "$RUNNER_TEMP/candidate" <<'PY'
          import pathlib, stat, sys, zipfile
          archive, destination = sys.argv[1:]
          with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
              assert z.testzip() is None, "CRC failure"
              for info in z.infolist():
                  path = pathlib.PurePosixPath(info.filename)
                  assert not path.is_absolute() and ".." not in path.parts, "unsafe ZIP path"
                  assert not stat.S_ISLNK(info.external_attr >> 16), "symlink rejected"
              z.extractall(destination)
          PY
          echo "root=$RUNNER_TEMP/candidate" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22.17.0

      - name: Verify governed evidence and frozen dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/validate_front02_package.mjs .
          npm ci
          npm run --workspace web-shell validate:front02
          npm run --workspace web-shell format:check
          npm run --workspace web-shell typecheck
          npm run --workspace web-shell lint
          npm run --workspace web-shell test

      - name: Run candidate-only and inherited regression browser gates
        working-directory: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm run --workspace web-shell test:browser -- tests/browser/front02.browser.spec.ts
          npm run --workspace web-shell test:visual
          npm run --workspace web-shell test:browser -- tests/browser/front01.browser.spec.ts --project=desktop

      - name: Publish run-owned review evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/front02-review"
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/front02-review/RESULT.json" <<EOF
          {"stage":"FRONT-02","candidate_sha256":"${{ inputs.candidate_sha256 || 'aaf980a2cd3b3b06d48218adaa68d109c8770e6abfcbef230197b51a87006179' }}","result":"PRECHECK_PASS_ONLY_IF_JOB_SUCCEEDS","acceptance":"NOT_GRANTED","governance":"independent GitHub Actions execution"}
          EOF
          cp "${{ steps.candidate.outputs.path }}" "$RUNNER_TEMP/front02-review/" || true
          cp -r "${{ steps.extract.outputs.root }}/evidence/front02" "$RUNNER_TEMP/front02-review/" || true
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: front02-governed-review-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/front02-review
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

```

name: PB01-I09 PostgreSQL 16 runtime

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - ".github/pb01-i09-pg16-trigger.txt"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-pg16:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Checkout official PostgreSQL 16.14 source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: postgres/postgres
          ref: REL_16_14
          path: postgres-src
      - name: Build PostgreSQL 16.14 runtime
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          prefix="$RUNNER_TEMP/pg16-runtime"
          cd postgres-src
          ./configure --prefix="$prefix" --without-icu --without-readline --without-zlib
          make -j2
          make install
          "$prefix/bin/postgres" --version | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/postgres-version.txt"
          test "$("$prefix/bin/postgres" --version)" = "postgres (PostgreSQL) 16.14"
          tar -C "$prefix" -czf "$RUNNER_TEMP/postgresql-16.14-linux-x64-runtime.tgz" .
          sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/postgresql-16.14-linux-x64-runtime.tgz" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/postgresql-runtime-sha256.txt"
      - name: Upload runtime
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pb01-i09-postgresql-16.14-linux-x64
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/postgresql-16.14-linux-x64-runtime.tgz
            ${{ runner.temp }}/postgres-version.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/postgresql-runtime-sha256.txt

### FILE `EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/.github/workflows/pb01-i09-pg16-toolchain.yml`

```text
name: PB01-I09 PostgreSQL 16 runtime

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "PB01-I09-PG16-TRIGGER.txt"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  package-pg16:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Ensure PostgreSQL 16 runtime
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          if [ ! -x /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/postgres ]; then
            sudo apt-get update
            sudo apt-get install -y postgresql-16 postgresql-client-16
          fi
          /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/postgres --version | tee postgresql-version.txt
          test "$(/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/postgres --version | awk '{print $3}' | cut -d. -f1)" = "16"
      - name: Package PostgreSQL 16 runtime with shared libraries
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          mkdir -p pg16-runtime/usr/lib/postgresql pg16-runtime/usr/share/postgresql pg16-runtime/lib
          sudo cp -a /usr/lib/postgresql/16 pg16-runtime/usr/lib/postgresql/
          sudo cp -a /usr/share/postgresql/16 pg16-runtime/usr/share/postgresql/
          : > postgresql-ldd.txt
          for exe in postgres initdb pg_ctl psql pg_dump pg_restore createdb dropdb pg_isready; do
            bin="/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/$exe"
            [ -x "$bin" ] || continue
            echo "### $exe" >> postgresql-ldd.txt
            ldd "$bin" | tee -a postgresql-ldd.txt
            ldd "$bin" | awk '/=> \/|^\// {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /^\//) print $i}' >> /tmp/pg16-libs.txt
          done
          sort -u /tmp/pg16-libs.txt > /tmp/pg16-libs.unique
          while IFS= read -r lib; do
            [ -f "$lib" ] || continue
            cp -L "$lib" "pg16-runtime/lib/$(basename "$lib")"
          done < /tmp/pg16-libs.unique
          tar -C pg16-runtime -czf postgresql-16-runtime.tgz usr lib
          sha256sum postgresql-16-runtime.tgz > postgresql-runtime-sha256.txt
      - name: Upload PostgreSQL runtime artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pb01-i09-postgresql-16-runtime
          path: |
            postgresql-16-runtime.tgz
            postgresql-version.txt
            postgresql-ldd.txt
            postgresql-runtime-sha256.txt
          retention-days: 2

```

```text
name: Verify and Package

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Generate locks, verify, and package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Set up Node.js 22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Generate Python lock file
        run: uv lock

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: uv sync --all-groups --frozen

      - name: Generate Node lock file and install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run full verification
        id: verify
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          make verify 2>&1 | tee VERIFICATION.log

      - name: Write verification status
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.verify.outcome }}" = "success" ]; then
            STATUS="PASS"
          else
            STATUS="FAIL"
          fi

          {
            echo "# Verification Result"
            echo
            echo "Status: **${STATUS}**"
            echo
            echo "Runner: GitHub Actions / ubuntu-latest"
            echo "Python: 3.12"
            echo "Node.js: 22"
            echo
            echo "This workflow is pack-agnostic: it verifies whatever pack(s)"
            echo "are implemented in the checked-out tree at run time (see"
            echo "docs/handover/ for the pack-specific report this run applies to)."
          } > VERIFICATION-RESULT.md

      - name: Create result archive
        if: always()
        run: |
          rm -rf .venv node_modules
          rm -rf frontend/web-shell/node_modules
          rm -rf frontend/web-shell/.next
          zip -r epd2-civic-os-verification-result.zip . \
            -x ".git/*" \
            -x "epd2-civic-os-verification-result.zip"

      - name: Upload result archive
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: epd2-civic-os-verification-result
          path: epd2-civic-os-verification-result.zip
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Mark workflow failed when verification failed
        if: steps.verify.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

```

### FILE `EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/CONTRIBUTING.md`

```text
# Contributing to EPD² Civic OS

## Workflow

- All changes are made through a Pull Request. Direct pushes to `main` are
  not permitted; `main` is protected and only receives changes via reviewed
  and merged Pull Requests.
- Every Pull Request must pass all required checks (`make verify` locally,
  and the CI workflow in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`) before it can be merged.
- Every Pull Request must use the template in
  `.github/pull_request_template.md`.

## Tests

- Tests are mandatory for any change that adds or modifies behavior.
- A Pull Request that reduces test coverage of an existing guarantee without
  justification will not be merged.
- Run `make test` (or the more targeted `make test-python`,
  `make test-typescript`, `make test-frontend`) before opening a Pull
  Request.

## Changing the canon

- The canonical domain and event model
  (`docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md`) is **not** editable as part
  of routine feature work.
- Any change to canonical entities, statuses, transitions, events, reason
  codes, or architectural invariants requires a dedicated
  `Architecture Decision Record` (ADR) under `docs/adr/`, using the template
  in `docs/adr/ADR-000-template.md`.
- A canon change is not implemented in working code until its ADR reaches
  status `accepted`.
- Use the `architecture_change.yml` issue template
  (`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/architecture_change.yml`) to propose such changes.

## Changing shared contracts

- Shared contracts under `contracts/` (OpenAPI specs, event schemas, JSON
  schemas, reason codes) are shared surface area for multiple modules.
- Any change to a shared contract must be versioned. Breaking changes
  require a new major version and must not silently replace the previous
  version's meaning.
- Consumers must be able to detect and reject an unsupported contract
  version (fail-closed), per `INV-10` of the canon.

## Commit messages

- Write commit messages in the imperative mood ("Add", "Fix", "Update"), one
  concise summary line, followed by an optional body explaining the "why"
  when it is not obvious.
- Reference the related package, issue, or ADR where relevant.

## Documentation requirements

- Any new module, package, or service must include a `README.md` describing
  its purpose, ownership, and boundaries.
- Any open question or ambiguity encountered during implementation must be
  recorded in `docs/review/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md` rather than resolved
  unilaterally.
- Any known limitation of the current state of the repository must be kept
  up to date in `docs/review/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md`.

```

```text
# GitHub Actions: one-click repository verification

This workflow is pack-agnostic: run it whenever `uv.lock` / `package-lock.json`
need regenerating against the current `pyproject.toml` / `package.json` (for
example, after a new pack adds workspace members or dependencies), or
whenever you want a real-network confirmation of `make verify` on a fresh
checkout. It always verifies whatever pack(s) are implemented in the tree at
run time — see `docs/handover/` for the pack-specific report that applies to
a given run.

1. Upload the **contents of this folder** to the repository root (not the outer folder itself).
2. Open **Actions**.
3. Select **Verify and Package**.
4. Click **Run workflow** → **Run workflow**.
5. When finished, open the run and download the artifact named `epd2-civic-os-verification-result`.

The workflow creates `uv.lock`, `package-lock.json`, runs the full verification pipeline (`make verify`), and packages the result (`VERIFICATION-RESULT.md`, `VERIFICATION.log`, the full tree) whether verification passes or fails.

```


### FILE `EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/LOCAL_VERIFICATION.md`

```text
# Local Verification

> **Status update:** PACK-01 has since been verified end-to-end (real
> `uv.lock`/`package-lock.json`, `next build`, and the full `make verify`
> pipeline) via `.github/workflows/verify-and-package.yml` on GitHub
> Actions — see `docs/handover/PACK-01-REPORT.md` (Revision 4) and
> `docs/handover/PACK-01-VERIFICATION.log` for the real output. The
> procedure below remains the reference for regenerating lock files or
> re-verifying locally (e.g. after a dependency bump) on any machine with
> normal internet access, or via `GITHUB_ACTIONS_START.md` if one isn't
> available.

This repository's structure, code, formatting, linting, type checking, and
tests have already been verified inside the sandbox this package was built
in, wherever that did not require a live PyPI/npm connection (see
`docs/handover/PACK-01-REPORT.md`). Two things could not be executed there:
generating real lock files, and a real `next build` (plus anything else
that needs installed `node_modules`). This document is the complete,
minimal procedure to finish that verification on a machine or CI runner
with normal internet access.

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.12 (`python3.12 --version` should print `3.12.x`)
- [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) (`uv --version`)
- Node.js 22 LTS (`node --version` should print `v22.x`)
- npm (bundled with Node; `npm --version`)
- No root privileges are required. Nothing here touches global system
  configuration.

## Install steps

Run from the repository root, in this order:

```bash
# 1. Python dependencies — resolves and locks packages/python/epd2-core's
#    workspace plus the dev dependency group (pytest, mypy, ruff, pydantic,
#    pre-commit) against PyPI, writing uv.lock.
uv lock
uv sync --all-groups

# 2. Node dependencies — resolves the npm workspaces
#    (packages/typescript/epd2-types, frontend/web-shell) against the npm
#    registry, writing package-lock.json.
npm install
```

## Expected lock files

Both are created at the **repository root** (not inside any subpackage):

```text
uv.lock              # from `uv lock` / `uv sync`
package-lock.json    # from `npm install`
```

Both must be committed to git once generated. Do not hand-edit either file
or generate a placeholder — they must be the real, tool-produced output of
the commands above (see `scripts/check_repository.py`, which requires both
to be present, and `scripts/verify_versions.py`, which is unaffected by
them but checks other version consistency).

## Build steps

After the install steps above succeed:

```bash
# Full verification pipeline (repository checks, format check, lint,
# typecheck, Python tests, TypeScript tests, frontend tests, frontend build)
make verify
```

Or, to run just the frontend build in isolation:

```bash
npm run build --workspace=frontend/web-shell
```

This is the real `next build` — it must be run as-is; it cannot be
replaced by a source-file check or by the smoke test alone (both of those
already passed inside the sandbox, but neither substitutes for an actual
build).

`make verify` runs, in order: `check-repository`, `format-check`
(`ruff format --check` + `npm run format:check`), `lint` (`ruff check` +
frontend ESLint), `typecheck` (`mypy` + both TypeScript packages' `tsc
--noEmit`), `test` (Python + TypeScript + frontend tests), then
`build-frontend` (`next build`). It stops at the first failing step.

## Expected output

If everything is in order, `make verify`'s last lines should show the
frontend build succeeding (a `next build` summary listing the built
routes) with no step above it having failed. Individually:

- `python scripts/check_repository.py` → `OK: all N required paths are present.`
- `python scripts/check_forbidden_files.py` → `OK: no forbidden paths found.`
- `python scripts/verify_versions.py` → `OK: all version sources are consistent.`
- `ruff format --check .` → all files already formatted
- `ruff check .` → `All checks passed!`
- `uv run mypy .` → `Success: no issues found in N source files`
- `uv run pytest` → all tests pass (0 failed) — this is the one number that
  will _change_ from the sandbox's last run: once `uv.lock` and
  `package-lock.json` exist, `test_no_required_paths_are_missing` (which
  failed inside the sandbox for exactly that reason) should pass too.
- `npm run typecheck` (both packages) → no errors
- `npm run lint --workspace=frontend/web-shell` → no errors
- `npm run test` (both packages) → all tests pass
- `npm run build --workspace=frontend/web-shell` → build completes,
  producing `frontend/web-shell/.next/`

After a successful run, `git status --short` should show only `uv.lock`,
`package-lock.json`, and (if not already gitignored in your checkout)
`frontend/web-shell/.next/` / `node_modules/` as untracked build output —
no source file should have been modified by `make verify` itself.

## Known sandbox limitation

The repository was built and verified as far as possible inside a
network-restricted cloud sandbox that blocks `pypi.org`,
`files.pythonhosted.org`, and `registry.npmjs.org` (confirmed via direct
`403 host_not_allowed` responses from that sandbox's egress gateway; no
usable internal package mirror was reachable either). Because of that:

- `uv.lock` and `package-lock.json` do not exist in this delivery — they
  must be generated by the install steps above.
- The frontend (`frontend/web-shell`) was never actually built there —
  `next` cannot be installed without npm registry access. Its build status
  in `docs/handover/PACK-01-REPORT.md` is recorded as
  **`NOT EXECUTED — NETWORK RESTRICTED`**, not `FAIL` and not `PASS`,
  because it was never actually attempted to completion — it should not be
  read as a failed build, only as an unrun one.
- Frontend ESLint (`npm run lint --workspace=frontend/web-shell`) is in the
  same state, for the same reason (`eslint-config-next` and
  `@eslint/eslintrc` are not installable there).
- Everything else in this repository (Python code, TypeScript source,
  repository-structure checks, formatting, Ruff, mypy, Python tests,
  TypeScript typecheck/tests verified via a local scratch workaround) was
  actually run inside the sandbox and passed — see
  `docs/handover/PACK-01-REPORT.md` for the exact commands and output.

Once you've run the steps above and have real results (especially the
final `make verify` output and the two lock files), send them back so the
handover report can be closed out with a genuine `PACK-01 PASS` or, if
something legitimately fails, a `PACK-01 FAIL` with the real failure
recorded.

## PACK-09 note (2026-07-26) — resolved by external CI

The PACK-09 rounds were produced in a sandbox with **no egress to package
registries**, so neither `uv sync --all-groups --frozen` nor `npm ci`
could be executed there. That limitation is now **closed**: the full
pipeline has since been run on GitHub Actions (ubuntu-latest, Python
3.12, Node.js 22) against the locked toolchain and passed.

The verified result is recorded in section 3 of
`docs/handover/PACK-09-IMPLEMENTATION-REPORT.md`, with the raw runner
output in `docs/handover/PACK-09-EXTERNAL-CI-VERIFICATION.log`.

Two corrections made offline were specifically confirmed by that run, and
are worth knowing if you regenerate anything:

1. **`uv.lock` was corrected by hand.** The original PACK-09 submission
   added `epd2-compliance-service` to `pyproject.toml` (root dependency,
   workspace member and `tool.uv.sources` entry) without regenerating the
   lock, so `uv sync --frozen` would have installed an environment
   _without_ the package. The four missing lock entries were added
   manually; no registry package version changed. The external
   `uv sync --all-groups --frozen` accepted the corrected file. If you
   re-run `uv lock` on a networked machine and it does not regenerate a
   byte-identical file, prefer the regenerated one and re-run the
   pipeline.
2. **`docs/handover/PACK-08-IMPLEMENTATION-REPORT.md` was reformatted with
   Prettier.** `npm run format:check` had already failed on the PACK-08
   baseline archive for that one file. The fix was applied offline with
   Prettier 3.8.1 while `package-lock.json` pins 3.9.6; the external
   `npm run format:check` under the locked version passed, so the two
   agree.

Everything else in this document is unchanged and still applies as the
reference procedure for re-verifying locally or regenerating lock files.

```text
.PHONY: setup format format-check lint typecheck test test-python test-typescript \
        test-frontend test-browser check-repository build-frontend verify clean

# --- make setup ---
# Installs Python dependencies via uv and Node dependencies via npm, using
# the committed lock files (uv.lock, package-lock.json). Requires no root
# privileges and does not modify global system configuration.
setup:
	uv sync --all-groups
	npm install

# --- make format ---
# Uses the Prettier version pinned in package-lock.json (via the root
# "format" script / `npm run`), never an ad hoc `npx --yes` download.
format:
	uv run ruff format .
	npm run format

# --- make format-check ---
format-check:
	uv run ruff format --check .
	npm run format:check

# --- make lint ---
lint:
	uv run ruff check .
	npm run lint --workspace=frontend/web-shell

# --- make typecheck ---
# A single repo-wide `uv run mypy .` is NOT used here: the 5 PACK-02
# services deliberately share identically-named test files (test_domain.py,
# test_application.py, etc., see each service's tests/ directory) with no
# __init__.py, so that pytest can use --import-mode=importlib and resolve
# same-named test files by full path. mypy has no equivalent mode - a single
# whole-repo invocation fails immediately with "Duplicate module named
# 'test_application'" (etc.) before checking a single real error. Instead,
# mypy is invoked once per group of files whose basenames don't collide
# within that one invocation: the core/scripts/repository-tests group, the
# shared contract-test suite, and then once per service. Every group must
# exit 0 for `make typecheck` to succeed - make's default recipe behavior
# aborts the whole target on the first non-zero exit code, so an earlier
# group's failure is never silently masked by a later group's success.
typecheck:
	uv run mypy packages/python/epd2-core scripts tests/repository conftest.py
	uv run mypy tests/contract
	uv run mypy services/account-service
	uv run mypy services/identity-service
	uv run mypy services/eligibility-service
	uv run mypy services/credential-service
	uv run mypy services/audit-core
	uv run mypy services/initiative-service
	uv run mypy services/deliberation-service
	uv run mypy services/moderation-service
	uv run mypy services/voting-service
	uv run mypy services/tally-service
	uv run mypy services/delegation-service
	uv run mypy services/transparency-service
	uv run mypy services/governance-service
	uv run mypy services/ai-processing-service
	uv run mypy services/membership-service
	uv run mypy services/organization-service
	uv run mypy services/compliance-service
	uv run mypy services/finance-service
	uv run mypy services/document-service
	uv run mypy services/privileged-access-service
	uv run mypy services/data-plane-service
	npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/typescript/epd2-types
	npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend/web-shell

# --- make test ---
test: test-python test-typescript test-frontend

test-python:
	uv run pytest

test-typescript:
	npm run test --workspace=packages/typescript/epd2-types

test-frontend:
	npm run test --workspace=frontend/web-shell

# --- make test-browser ---
test-browser:
	npm run test:browser --workspace=frontend/web-shell

# --- make check-repository ---
check-repository:
	uv run python scripts/check_repository.py
	uv run python scripts/check_forbidden_files.py
	uv run python scripts/verify_versions.py

# --- make build-frontend ---
build-frontend:
	npm run build --workspace=frontend/web-shell

# --- make verify ---
# Runs the full sequential verification pipeline, as run in CI:
# 1. repository checks, 2. format check, 3. lint, 4. typecheck,
# 5. Python tests, 6. TypeScript tests, 7. frontend tests, 8. frontend build,
# 9. browser, accessibility, and visual regression tests.
# Does not install or download anything itself — run `make setup` first.
# Fails on the first non-zero exit code.
verify: check-repository format-check lint typecheck test build-frontend test-browser

# --- make clean ---
clean:
	rm -rf .venv
	rm -rf packages/python/epd2-core/.pytest_cache packages/python/epd2-core/.mypy_cache
	rm -rf .pytest_cache .mypy_cache .ruff_cache
	find . -name "__pycache__" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
	rm -rf node_modules packages/typescript/epd2-types/node_modules frontend/web-shell/node_modules
	rm -rf frontend/web-shell/.next frontend/web-shell/out
	rm -rf packages/typescript/epd2-types/dist

```

```text
# PACK-12 CI FORMAT CORRECTION 2

**NOT PASS.**

The PACK-12 candidate's status is unchanged:
**LOCAL VERIFICATION INCOMPLETE / EXTERNAL CI PENDING / NOT FINAL PASS.**

---

## Outcome: no file was formatted. One file must be deleted.

CI reports a format failure on:

```text
docs/handover/PACK-12-FIR-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md
```

**That file is a stray duplicate. It should be removed, not formatted.**

This correction therefore contains **no repository file**. Applying it
means performing one deletion:

```bash
git rm docs/handover/PACK-12-FIR-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md
```

Nothing else changes. No content, semantics, code, test, version, canon,
dependency, CI configuration or other file is touched.

---

## Why deletion rather than formatting

### The file is not part of PACK-12 as delivered

The FIR Coverage Matrix has exactly one home in this repository:

```text
docs/packs/PACK-12/PACK-12-FIR-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md
```

That is where it sits in **every** archive delivered for PACK-12 — the
specification package, its correction, the implementation candidate, the
corrected candidate, and format correction 1. None of them has ever
contained a file at `docs/handover/PACK-12-FIR-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md`.

The copy CI is failing on exists only in the working repository. It was
not produced by any PACK-12 round.

### The real matrix is already correctly formatted

```text
prettier --check docs/packs/PACK-12/PACK-12-FIR-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md
  →  All matched files use Prettier code style!
```

It was formatted by CI format correction 1 and needs nothing further.

### Nothing references the stray path

Verified across the whole repository:

| Checked                                        | Result                                                    |
| ---------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `scripts/check_repository.py` `REQUIRED_PATHS` | registers `docs/packs/PACK-12/...` only                   |
| `tests/`, `Makefile`, `.github/`               | no reference to the handover path                         |
| All Markdown in the repository                 | no reference to the handover path                         |
| `PACK-12-IMPLEMENTATION-CANDIDATE-REPORT.md`   | cites `docs/packs/PACK-12/PACK-12-FIR-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md` |
| `PACK-12-SPEC-ADR-REPORT.md`                   | cites `docs/packs/PACK-12/PACK-12-FIR-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md` |

Deleting it breaks no required-path check, no link and no test. Keeping
it means maintaining two copies of one governance document that can drift
apart — the same hazard the register's own single-file policy (section 23) exists to prevent.

### Formatting it would have required guessing its content

The file is not present in this build environment, so its bytes are
unknown here. Formatting the `docs/packs/` copy and shipping it under the
handover path would have overwritten the working repository's file with
different content — precisely what the instruction "do not change
content" forbids. That option was declined rather than taken quietly.

---

## How the origin is most likely explained

The first CI format correction request listed sixteen paths, one of which
was `docs/handover/PACK-12-FIR-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md`. That path did not
exist then either; the response to that round stated so explicitly and
formatted the fifteen real files. It appears the missing path was
subsequently satisfied by creating a copy at that location. The copy has
never been formatted, which is why CI now fails on it.

---

## After the deletion

```text
prettier --check .
```

should report only files unrelated to PACK-12, if any. Note the caveat
carried over from format correction 1: this environment cannot install
the pinned `prettier@3.9.6` (npm returns `403 Forbidden`), so local
checks were run with 3.8.1. Three pre-existing files that are
byte-identical to the PACK-11 FINAL PASS are flagged by 3.8.1 and not by
3.9.6, and were deliberately left untouched:

```text
docs/adr/ADR-051-rechenschaftsbericht-lifecycle-snapshot-and-authority-semantics.md
frontend/web-shell/foundation/storage-policy.ts
frontend/web-shell/foundation/types.ts
```

This correction changes none of them.

```

Verified mechanically: with emphasis markers, table padding and line

is **identical** before and after. No wording changed.

---

## Three things the operator needs to know

### 1. One requested path does not exist

The request listed 16 files, including
`docs/handover/PACK-12-FIR-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md`. **That file does not
exist and was not created.** The FIR coverage matrix lives at
`docs/packs/PACK-12/PACK-12-FIR-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md`, which was also on
the list and _was_ formatted. The list therefore named 15 real files, one
of them twice under two directories.

### 2. Prettier version skew — the check was run with 3.8.1, CI pins 3.9.6

`package-lock.json` pins `prettier@3.9.6`. This environment cannot reach
the npm registry (`403 Forbidden` on both the public registry and the
internal mirror), so `npm ci` cannot run and 3.9.6 could not be
installed. The formatting was performed with **Prettier 3.8.1**, which
satisfies the declared `^3.3.0` range but is not the pinned build.

The two versions demonstrably disagree. Three files in the repository
fail `prettier --check` under 3.8.1 while being **byte-identical to the
PACK-11 FINAL PASS**, which passed CI under 3.9.6:

```text
docs/adr/ADR-051-rechenschaftsbericht-lifecycle-snapshot-and-authority-semantics.md
frontend/web-shell/foundation/storage-policy.ts
frontend/web-shell/foundation/types.ts
```

3.8.1 wants to escape `no*` as `no\*` inside a markdown table in the
ADR, and to break a TypeScript union across lines in `types.ts`. 3.9.6
does neither. **These three files were deliberately left untouched** —
they are correct under the version CI actually runs, and "fixing" them
here would have broken them in CI.

Consequently, `prettier --check .` repository-wide still reports those
three under 3.8.1. That is expected and is not a defect in this
correction.

**What this means for confidence:** the 15 corrected files contain no
changes of the classes where 3.8.1 and 3.9.6 were observed to differ (no
escape-sequence changes at all; the changes are emphasis-marker
normalisation `*x*` → `_x_`, table column padding, and blank-line
removal). The risk that 3.9.6 disagrees is low but **not zero**, and it
cannot be eliminated without the pinned binary.

### 3. One change was NOT pure formatting, and had to be prevented

In `docs/adr/README.md` the phrase _"extensible by configuration + ADR
review"_ was wrapped so that `+ ADR review` began a line. Prettier parses
a leading `+` as a **list bullet**: `--write` converted the sentence into
a bulleted list (`- ADR review", and canon 19e.16 ...`) and re-indented
the rest of the paragraph as list continuation. That is a semantic
corruption, not formatting, and it was not shipped.

The fix was to move the line break so the `+` is no longer at the start
of a line — the sentence now reads
`"by configuration + ADR review"` on one line. **No word was changed**,
and Prettier's own output was then taken as-is. This is the same failure
mode PACK-11 hit with a `+` at the start of a hash-formula line, handled
the same way.

489: 1. **Сохранённая версия никогда не изменяется, и любое изменение
490:    обнаруживается.** `version_hash = sha256(canonical_dumps(hashable_fields(v)) + previous_version_hash)`
491:    — то же правило, что у `audit-core`, поэтому
492:    одна процедура проверки покрывает обе цепочки. Три независимые защиты:
493:    обнаружение, отказ выполнить и отказ строить поверх. Это tamper
494:    **evidence**, а не tamper resistance — см.
495:    `docs/handover/PACK-11-KNOWN-LIMITATIONS.md`.
496: 2. **Содержимое хранится здесь и не покидает контур.** Ни одно событие, ни
497:    одно поле аудита, ни одна проекция не несут байтов, извлечённого
501:    версии; отсутствие сообщается как явное `not_determined`.

### FILE `EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/SECURITY.md`

```text
# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report security issues through the private project communication channel.

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

## Rules

- Do not publish secrets (API keys, tokens, credentials, private keys) in
  this repository, in commits, in issues, or in pull requests.
- Do not use real personal data anywhere in this repository — no real names,
  emails, government identifiers, or identity documents. Use synthetic
  fixtures only.
- Do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities publicly before they have been
  triaged through the private project communication channel.
- There is currently no production deployment of this platform. This
  infrastructure skeleton (CLAUDE-PACK-01) does not expose any running
  service, API, or database.
- Any security-critical change (authentication, credential handling,
  cryptography, anonymity guarantees, audit integrity) requires a separate,
  dedicated review in addition to normal code review, and — where it touches
  the canon — an accepted ADR.

## Scope

This policy applies to the `epd2-civic-os` repository as a whole. As
individual services are introduced in later packages, they may define
additional, more specific security requirements.

```

"""Root pytest conftest.

Ensures the repository root is importable so that top-level `scripts`
package (repository structure checks) can be imported by
`tests/repository/*.py` regardless of pytest's import mode. Tests are
expected to be run from the repository root.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).parent.resolve()

if str(REPO_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))

### FILE `EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/README.md`

```text
# Contracts

Versioned contracts between EPD² Civic OS modules. As of `CLAUDE-PACK-02`
this directory contains real, executable content for the five services'
canonical entities and events - `CLAUDE-PACK-01` shipped only the
directory structure and a documentary reason-code list.

## Directories

- `openapi/` — `pack-02.yaml`: transport-neutral API contracts for the five
  PACK-02 services (pack section 11). No production HTTP server ships in
  this pack.
- `events/` — versioned JSON Schemas for each canonical event's `payload`
  (canon sections 20–21). One schema per payload shape actually emitted by
  a PACK-02 service; wraps into `schemas/event-envelope.schema.json`'s
  `payload` field.
- `schemas/` — JSON Schema descriptions of the canonical entities in scope
  (`Account`, `IdentityRecord`, `EligibilityRule`, `EligibilityDecision`,
  `EligibilitySnapshot`, `ParticipationCredential`, `AuditEvent`) plus the
  canonical event envelope itself.
- `reason-codes/` — `pack-02.yml`: the executable, centralized reason-code
  registry (pack section 10). See `reason-codes/README.md` and
  `docs/adr/ADR-004-reason-code-registry.md`.
- `fixtures/` — test fixtures for contract tests (canon section 27),
  populated under Task 20's `tests/contract/` suite.

## Validation

Every schema here is standard JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) and is validated
two ways:

- In CI (`.github/workflows/verify-and-package.yml`), with the real
  `jsonschema` package (network access available there).
- Locally in this sandbox (no network access to install `jsonschema`),
  with `epd2_core.minimal_json_schema` - a small, dependency-free
  validator supporting a documented subset of JSON Schema keywords
  (`type`, `required`, `properties`, `additionalProperties`, `enum`,
  `items`, `minLength`, `format: uuid|date-time`). Every schema in this
  directory is written to validate correctly under both.

`additionalProperties: false` on `participation-credential.schema.json`
and the `credential.issued`/`credential.revoked` event payload schemas is
a load-bearing identity-leakage control (CT-00-08): no identity field
(`identity_record_id`, `person_id`, `account_id`, `full_name`,
`date_of_birth`, `address`, `email`, `eid_subject`) can appear on any
instance that validates against them.

## Versioning rule

Any change to a contract in these directories is versioned. A backward
incompatible change requires a new major version, not a silent
replacement of an existing version's meaning (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` and
canon section 25).

```

    "status"

      "type": ["string", "null"],
      "enum": ["final", "invalidated", null]
    },
    "created_at": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" },
    "decided_at": { "type": ["string", "null"], "format": "date-time" },
    "supersedes_decision_id": { "type": ["string", "null"], "format": "uuid" },
    "status": { "type": "string", "enum": ["proposed", "approved", "rejected"] }
  }
}

      "minLength": 1
    },

        "institutional_oversight_without_data_access",
        null
      ]
    },
    "policy_version": { "type": ["string", "null"] },

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://epd2.example/contracts/events/vote-envelope-status-changed-payload.v1.schema.json",
  "title": "vote.received / vote.validated event payload (v1)",
  "description": "docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 20.10. Produced by epd2_voting_service.events.vote_envelope_state_payload, shared verbatim by build_vote_received_event (vote.received) and build_vote_validated_event (vote.validated) - verified by reading events.py, both call the shared private _build_vote_event helper with the identical payload function. Deliberately excludes encrypted_or_encoded_choice from the wire event (only integrity_hash, already a one-way digest, travels) - see vote_envelope_full_state_payload for Audit Core's complete snapshot. additionalProperties: false is a load-bearing vote-linkability control (CT-00-09, canon section 15.3's 'Запрет'): account_id, person_id, identity_record_id, full_name, email, membership_id, and identity_provider_reference are all forbidden and cannot appear on a payload that validates against this schema.",
  "type": "object",

  "required": [
    "vote_envelope_id",
    "ballot_id",
    "credential_proof",
    "integrity_hash",
    "validation_status",
    "included_in_tally"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "vote_envelope_id": { "type": "string", "format": "uuid" },
    "ballot_id": { "type": "string", "format": "uuid" },
    "credential_proof": { "type": "string", "format": "uuid" },
    "integrity_hash": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "validation_status": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "received",
        "validated",
        "rejected",
        "superseded",
        "included",
        "quarantined"
      ]
    },
    "included_in_tally": { "type": "boolean" }
  }
}
