### FILE `EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/openapi/pack-02.yaml`

```text
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: EPD² Civic OS — CLAUDE-PACK-02 service contracts
  version: "0.1.0"
  description: >
    Transport-neutral API contracts for the five PACK-02 services (pack
    section 11). No production HTTP server ships in this pack — these
    paths document the minimal operation set pack section 11 requires
    (record identity verification; evaluate eligibility; create
    eligibility snapshot; issue credential; validate credential; revoke
    credential; read an audit event by a permitted identifier) and are
    exercised in tests via the underlying application-layer functions
    directly, not over HTTP. Service boundaries are structural here too:
    no single path ever returns identity data together with a
    ParticipationCredential (CT-00-08 / INV-01), and each path is served
    by exactly one service, matching the ownership matrix in
    docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 22.
externalDocs:
  description: Canonical domain model
  url: ../../docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md

servers:
  - url: https://identity.epd2.example
    description: identity-service (not deployed in PACK-02 — contract only)
  - url: https://eligibility.epd2.example
    description: eligibility-service (not deployed in PACK-02 — contract only)
  - url: https://credential.epd2.example
    description: credential-service (not deployed in PACK-02 — contract only)
  - url: https://audit.epd2.example
    description: audit-core (not deployed in PACK-02 — contract only)

paths:
  /identity/verifications:
    post:
      operationId: recordIdentityVerification
      summary: Record the outcome of an identity verification attempt
      description: >
        Owned by identity-service. Maps to
        epd2_identity_service.application.record_verification_result.
        CT-00-06: rejected with 403 if the actor is not authorized.
        CT-00-02/03: rejected with 422 for an unknown status value or a
        forbidden transition (docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md,
        section 7.3; canon events section 20.2).
      tags: [identity-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [identity_record_id, outcome]
              properties:
                identity_record_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                outcome:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      verified,
                      failed,
                      expired,
                      duplicate_suspected,
                      manual_review_required,
                    ]
                expires_at: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
                duplicate_check_status: { type: [string, "null"] }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Verification result recorded; returns the updated IdentityRecord and, if a canonical event resulted, its envelope.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [record]
                properties:
                  record: { $ref: "../schemas/identity-record.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED — actor is not authorized (CT-00-06).
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such identity_record_id (ADR-004).
        "422":
          description: VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS or VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION (CT-00-02/03).

  /eligibility/decisions:
    post:
      operationId: evaluateEligibility
      summary: Evaluate one subject against one frozen eligibility rule version
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.evaluate_eligibility. Never
        accepts or returns identity data — evaluated_claims is a plain
        string map supplied by the caller (structural boundary, see
        services/eligibility-service/README.md).
      tags: [eligibility-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  eligibility_rule_id,
                  rule_version,
                  subject_reference,
                  process_id,
                  evaluated_claims,
                  evaluator_version,
                ]
              properties:
                eligibility_rule_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                rule_version: { type: integer }
                subject_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
                process_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                evaluated_claims: { type: object }
                evaluator_version: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Decision recorded; canon's eligibility.evaluated event emitted (docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 20.3).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [decision, event]
                properties:
                  decision:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/eligibility-decision.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06).
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such (eligibility_rule_id, rule_version) (ADR-004).

  /eligibility/snapshots:
    post:
      operationId: createEligibilitySnapshot
      summary: Create an immutable snapshot from a set of eligible decisions
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.create_eligibility_snapshot.
        Fail-closed (422) if any supplied decision does not match the
        given rule/version or is not `eligible` (docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md,
        section 9.3).
      tags: [eligibility-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [eligibility_rule_id, rule_version, eligible_decision_ids]
              properties:
                eligibility_rule_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                rule_version: { type: integer }
                eligible_decision_ids:
                  type: array
                  items: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Snapshot created; canon's eligibility.snapshot_created event emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [snapshot, event]
                properties:
                  snapshot:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/eligibility-snapshot.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06).
        "422":
          description: A supplied decision does not match the rule/version or is not eligible.

  /credentials:
    post:
      operationId: issueParticipationCredential
      summary: Issue a new opaque ParticipationCredential
      description: >
        Owned by credential-service. Maps to
        epd2_credential_service.application.issue_participation_credential.
        The response never contains identity_record_id, person_id,
        account_id, or any other identity field (CT-00-08; enforced
        structurally by additionalProperties: false on
        participation-credential.schema.json).
      tags: [credential-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  credential_type,
                  scope_type,
                  scope_id,
                  valid_from,
                  expires_at,
                  rule_version,
                  eligibility_snapshot_digest,
                ]
              properties:
                credential_type:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      space_access,
                      initiative_support,
                      ballot_access,
                      delegation_access,
                      audit_access,
                    ]
                scope_type: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                scope_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                valid_from: { type: string, format: date-time }
                expires_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
                usage_limit: { type: [integer, "null"] }
                rule_version: { type: integer }
                eligibility_snapshot_digest: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Credential issued; canon's credential.issued event emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [credential, event]
                properties:
                  credential:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/participation-credential.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06).
        "409":
          description: CREDENTIAL_DUPLICATE_ISSUANCE_CONFLICT (ADR-004).

  /credentials/{credentialId}/validate:
    post:
      operationId: validateParticipationCredential
      summary: Fail-closed validation of a ParticipationCredential
      description: >
        Owned by credential-service. Maps to
        epd2_credential_service.application.validate_participation_credential.
        A query, not a state change — no canonical event on success
        (ADR-002). The response structurally cannot contain identity data
        (ValidationResult has no identity-linked fields, see
        epd2_credential_service.domain.ValidationResult) and, on failure,
        never reveals `scope_type`/`scope_id`/`expires_at` (fail-closed,
        pack section 6.4).
      tags: [credential-service]
      parameters:
        - name: credentialId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              properties:
                required_scope_type: { type: [string, "null"] }
                required_scope_id: { type: [string, "null"], format: uuid }
                expected_rule_version: { type: [integer, "null"] }
                expected_digest: { type: [string, "null"] }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Validation result (valid=false never leaks scope/expiry — pack section 6.4).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: false
                required: [valid, reason_codes, credential_version]
                properties:
                  valid: { type: boolean }
                  scope_type: { type: [string, "null"] }
                  scope_id: { type: [string, "null"], format: uuid }
                  expires_at: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
                  reason_codes: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
                  credential_version: { type: integer }

  /credentials/{credentialId}/revoke:
    post:
      operationId: revokeParticipationCredential
      summary: Revoke a previously issued ParticipationCredential
      description: >
        Owned by credential-service. Maps to
        epd2_credential_service.application.revoke_participation_credential.
      tags: [credential-service]
      parameters:
        - name: credentialId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Credential revoked; canon's credential.revoked event emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [credential, event]
                properties:
                  credential:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/participation-credential.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06).
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such credential_id (ADR-004).

  /audit/events/{auditEventId}:
    get:
      operationId: getAuditEventById
      summary: Read a single AuditEvent by its permitted identifier
      description: >
        Owned by audit-core. Maps to
        epd2_audit_core.application.get_by_event_id. Per canon section
        18.1, Audit Core has "отдельные права чтения" (separate read
        permissions) from the services that append to it — this path is
        intentionally the *only* read surface this contract exposes for
        AuditEvent, and it is scoped by a single permitted identifier
        rather than an open listing, to keep audit-read access
        auditable and narrow in its own right.
      tags: [audit-core]
      parameters:
        - name: auditEventId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The AuditEvent, if the caller is permitted to read it.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "../schemas/audit-event.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED — caller lacks Audit Core read permission.
        "404":
          description: No AuditEvent exists for the given audit_event_id.

components: {}

```

```text
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: EPD² Civic OS — CLAUDE-PACK-04 service contracts
  version: "0.1.0"
  description: >
    Transport-neutral API contract for the one PACK-04 service
    (transparency-service, ADR-011). No production HTTP server ships in
    this pack — these paths document, one-to-one, every real command
    function in epd2_transparency_service.application and are exercised
    in tests via those application-layer functions directly, not over
    HTTP. Every path maps to exactly one real command; none of this
    file's paths invent an HTTP surface a command function does not
    already provide. Request bodies list only genuine business fields —
    actor identity, authorization, correlation/causation ids, the clock,
    and the idempotency event_id are transport/session concerns, the
    same convention contracts/openapi/pack-02.yaml and pack-03.yaml
    already follow. Per canon section 19a.6 / CT-00-08, no path or
    schema in this file ever declares account_id, person_id,
    identity_record_id, participation_credential_id, vote_envelope_id,
    encrypted_or_encoded_choice, credential_proof, or any of the four
    *_role_id fields as part of a *response* body — those are internal
    fields, present only in the stored entity schemas
    (contracts/schemas/*.json), never in a public wire payload.
externalDocs:
  description: Canonical domain model
  url: ../../docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md

servers:
  - url: https://transparency.epd2.example
    description: transparency-service (not deployed in PACK-04 — contract only)

paths:
  # ==========================================================================
  # transparency-service — PublicLedgerEntry
  # ==========================================================================
  /public-ledger-entries:
    post:
      operationId: publishLedgerEntry
      summary: Publish a new PublicLedgerEntry
      description: >
        Owned by transparency-service. Maps to
        epd2_transparency_service.application.publish_ledger_entry.
        Creates the entry already in status=published (canon 19a.1) —
        content is filtered through the active DisclosurePolicy for
        subject_type before storage.
      tags: [transparency-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  public_ledger_entry_id,
                  subject_type,
                  subject_id,
                  subject_event_id,
                  raw_content,
                ]
              properties:
                public_ledger_entry_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                subject_type:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      initiative,
                      initiative_version,
                      moderation_decision,
                      result_publication,
                      ai_processing_record,
                    ]
                subject_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                subject_event_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                raw_content: { type: object }
                redaction_notice: { type: [string, "null"] }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Ledger entry published; transparency.ledger_entry_published emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [entry]
                properties:
                  entry: { $ref: "../schemas/public-ledger-entry.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED — actor is not authorized (CT-00-06).
        "409":
          description: LEDGER_ENTRY_ALREADY_PUBLISHED — use the correction path instead.
        "422":
          description: PUBLICATION_NOT_ALLOWED — no active DisclosurePolicy for subject_type.

  /public-ledger-entries/{supersedes_entry_id}/corrections:
    post:
      operationId: correctLedgerEntry
      summary: Publish a correcting PublicLedgerEntry
      description: >
        Owned by transparency-service. Maps to
        epd2_transparency_service.application.correct_ledger_entry. The
        original entry is never rewritten (canon 19a.1) — this creates a
        new row with supersedes_entry_id set.
      tags: [transparency-service]
      parameters:
        - name: supersedes_entry_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [new_public_ledger_entry_id, raw_content]
              properties:
                new_public_ledger_entry_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                raw_content: { type: object }
                redaction_notice: { type: [string, "null"] }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Correcting entry published; transparency.ledger_entry_corrected emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [entry]
                properties:
                  entry: { $ref: "../schemas/public-ledger-entry.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED — actor is not authorized.
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — supersedes_entry_id does not exist.

  # ==========================================================================
  # transparency-service — AuditExportPackage
  # ==========================================================================
  /audit-export-packages:
    post:
      operationId: generateAuditExportPackage
      summary: Generate a new AuditExportPackage in status=generated
      description: >
        Owned by transparency-service. Maps to
        epd2_transparency_service.application.generate_audit_export_package.
        Builds chain_proof from epd2_audit_core's matching events via the
        new, additive, read-only
        epd2_audit_core.application.list_by_target_types function
        (ADR-012 item 4).
      tags: [transparency-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  audit_export_package_id,
                  scope_description,
                  included_target_types,
                ]
              properties:
                audit_export_package_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                scope_description: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                included_target_types:
                  type: array
                  minItems: 1
                  items:
                    type: string
                    enum:
                      [
                        initiative,
                        initiative_version,
                        ballot,
                        moderation_case,
                        moderation_decision,
                        result_publication,
                      ]
                redaction_notice: { type: [string, "null"] }
                supersedes_package_id: { type: [string, "null"], format: uuid }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Package generated; transparency.audit_export_generated emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [package]
                properties:
                  package:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/audit-export-package.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED — actor is not authorized.

  /audit-export-packages/{audit_export_package_id}/publish:
    post:
      operationId: publishAuditExportPackage
      summary: generated -> published (may also supersede an old package)
      description: >
        Owned by transparency-service. Maps to
        epd2_transparency_service.application.publish_audit_export_package.
        If the package's own supersedes_package_id is set, this call also
        transitions that referenced package published -> superseded
        (canon 19a.2) — the old package's content is never rewritten,
        only its status.
      tags: [transparency-service]
      parameters:
        - name: audit_export_package_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Package published; transparency.audit_export_published emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [package]
                properties:
                  package:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/audit-export-package.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED — actor is not authorized.
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — unknown audit_export_package_id.
        "409":
          description: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION — package is not in status=generated.

  /audit-export-packages/{audit_export_package_id}/verify:
    get:
      operationId: verifyAuditExportPackage
      summary: Recompute and check package_digest (public verification only)
      description: >
        Owned by transparency-service. Maps to
        epd2_transparency_service.application.verify_audit_export_package.
        Proves chain-continuity/ordering/non-modification of the exported
        segment (canon 19a.2's "Семантика проверки") — never a
        recomputation of the original private AuditEvent.event_hash
        values.
      tags: [transparency-service]
      parameters:
        - name: audit_export_package_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Verification result.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: false
                required: [is_intact, recomputed_digest]
                properties:
                  is_intact: { type: boolean }
                  recomputed_digest: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — unknown audit_export_package_id.

  # ==========================================================================
  # transparency-service — DisclosurePolicy
  # ==========================================================================
  /disclosure-policies:
    post:
      operationId: defineDisclosurePolicy
      summary: Define a new DisclosurePolicy in status=draft
      description: >
        Owned by transparency-service. Maps to
        epd2_transparency_service.application.define_disclosure_policy.
      tags: [transparency-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  disclosure_policy_id,
                  applies_to_subject_type,
                  field_rules,
                  effective_from,
                  version,
                ]
              properties:
                disclosure_policy_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                applies_to_subject_type: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                field_rules:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    additionalProperties: false
                    required: [field_path, disclosure_class, transformation]
                    properties:
                      field_path: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                      disclosure_class:
                        type: string
                        enum: [public, redacted, restricted, prohibited]
                      transformation:
                        type: string
                        enum:
                          [
                            none,
                            generalize_to_role_scope,
                            band_small_cell,
                            suppress,
                            hash,
                          ]
                      replacement_label: { type: [string, "null"] }
                small_cell_threshold: { type: integer, minimum: 0, default: 10 }
                effective_from: { type: string, format: date-time }
                version: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Policy defined; transparency.disclosure_policy_defined emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [policy]
                properties:
                  policy: { $ref: "../schemas/disclosure-policy.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED — actor is not authorized.

  /disclosure-policies/{disclosure_policy_id}/activate:
    post:
      operationId: activateDisclosurePolicy
      summary: draft -> active (may also supersede the previously-active version)
      description: >
        Owned by transparency-service. Maps to
        epd2_transparency_service.application.activate_disclosure_policy.
        Requires approved_by_role_id (INV-08). If another policy is
        already active for the same applies_to_subject_type, this call
        also transitions it active -> superseded (canon 19a.3).
      tags: [transparency-service]
      parameters:
        - name: disclosure_policy_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [approved_by_role_id]
              properties:
                approved_by_role_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Policy activated; transparency.disclosure_policy_activated emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [policy]
                properties:
                  policy: { $ref: "../schemas/disclosure-policy.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED — actor is not authorized.
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — unknown disclosure_policy_id.
        "409":
          description: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION — policy is not in status=draft.

  # ==========================================================================
  # transparency-service — LobbyLogEntry
  # ==========================================================================
  /lobby-log-entries:
    post:
      operationId: submitLobbyLogEntry
      summary: Submit a new LobbyLogEntry in status=submitted
      description: >
        Owned by transparency-service. Maps to
        epd2_transparency_service.application.submit_lobby_log_entry.
        Rejects a submission missing any mandatory field
        (LOBBY_LOG_ENTRY_INCOMPLETE) before construction (canon 19a.4).
      tags: [transparency-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  lobby_log_entry_id,
                  organization_name,
                  related_subject_type,
                  related_subject_id,
                  contact_date,
                  contact_method,
                  topic_summary,
                ]
              properties:
                lobby_log_entry_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                organization_name: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                related_subject_type:
                  type: string
                  enum: [initiative, ballot, amendment]
                related_subject_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                contact_date: { type: string, format: date-time }
                contact_method:
                  type: string
                  enum: [meeting, written_submission, call, other]
                topic_summary: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Entry submitted; transparency.lobby_log_entry_submitted emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [entry]
                properties:
                  entry: { $ref: "../schemas/lobby-log-entry.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED — actor is not authorized.
        "422":
          description: LOBBY_LOG_ENTRY_INCOMPLETE — a mandatory field is missing.

  /lobby-log-entries/{lobby_log_entry_id}/publish:
    post:
      operationId: publishLobbyLogEntry
      summary: submitted -> published (mandatory automated validation, no default human review)
      description: >
        Owned by transparency-service. Maps to
        epd2_transparency_service.application.publish_lobby_log_entry.
        ADR-015 item 4 (amended): no mandatory human pre-publication
        review by default; mandatory automated completeness/
        prohibited-field/disclosure-policy validation.
      tags: [transparency-service]
      parameters:
        - name: lobby_log_entry_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Entry published; transparency.lobby_log_entry_published emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [entry]
                properties:
                  entry: { $ref: "../schemas/lobby-log-entry.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED — actor is not authorized.
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — unknown lobby_log_entry_id.
        "422":
          description: LOBBY_LOG_ENTRY_INCOMPLETE or PUBLICATION_NOT_ALLOWED.

  /lobby-log-entries/{supersedes_entry_id}/corrections:
    post:
      operationId: correctLobbyLogEntry
      summary: Publish a correcting LobbyLogEntry
      description: >
        Owned by transparency-service. Maps to
        epd2_transparency_service.application.correct_lobby_log_entry.
        Only allowed against an already-published original (canon
        19a.4); the original row is never rewritten.
      tags: [transparency-service]
      parameters:
        - name: supersedes_entry_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  new_lobby_log_entry_id,
                  organization_name,
                  related_subject_type,
                  related_subject_id,
                  contact_date,
                  contact_method,
                  topic_summary,
                ]
              properties:
                new_lobby_log_entry_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                organization_name: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                related_subject_type:
                  type: string
                  enum: [initiative, ballot, amendment]
                related_subject_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                contact_date: { type: string, format: date-time }
                contact_method:
                  type: string
                  enum: [meeting, written_submission, call, other]
                topic_summary: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Correcting entry published; transparency.lobby_log_entry_corrected emitted.
          content:
            application/json:

                type: object
                required: [entry]
                properties:

openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: EPD² Civic OS — CLAUDE-PACK-05 service contracts
  version: "0.1.0"
  description: >
    Transport-neutral API contract for the one PACK-05 service
    (governance-service, ADR-016). No production HTTP server ships in
    this pack — these paths document, one-to-one, every real command
    function in epd2_governance_service.application and are exercised in
    tests via those application-layer functions directly, not over
    HTTP. Every path maps to exactly one real command; none of this
    file's paths invent an HTTP surface a command function does not
    already provide. Request bodies list only genuine business fields —
    actor identity, authorization, correlation/causation ids, the clock,
    and the idempotency event_id are transport/session concerns, the
    same convention contracts/openapi/pack-02.yaml through
    pack-04.yaml already follow.

    Per canon 19b.1/19b.6 and ADR-020, no path or schema in this file
    ever declares actor_id, assigned_by, proposed_by_role_id,
    approved_by_role_id, rejected_by_role_id, or
    submitter_authorization_reference as part of a *response* body —
    those are internal fields, present only in the stored entity
    schemas (contracts/schemas/*.json), never in a public wire payload
    (mirroring pack-04.yaml's identical rule for its own restricted
    fields).

    The deployment-time bootstrap seed command
    (epd2_governance_service.bootstrap.run_bootstrap_seed) is
    deliberately absent from this file — item 6 of PACK-05's required
    scope states it is "not exposed through normal API"; it has no
    HTTP-shaped contract at all, by design.

    voting-service's own new command
    (epd2_voting_service.application.invalidate_ballot, ADR-017 Option
    B) is documented in contracts/openapi/pack-03.yaml under the
    voting-service tag, not here — it is physically owned by
    voting-service, even though it reads a GovernanceDecision produced
    by this pack.
externalDocs:
  description: Canonical domain model
  url: ../../docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md

servers:
  - url: https://governance.epd2.example
    description: governance-service (not deployed in PACK-05 — contract only)

paths:
  # ==========================================================================
  # governance-service — RoleAssignment
  # ==========================================================================
  /role-assignments:
    post:
      operationId: requestRoleAssignment
      summary: Create a new RoleAssignment in pending status
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.request_role_assignment.
        role_code must be one of the 8 pilot role codes (ADR-020 §5);
        the granting RoleAssignment (granter_role_assignment_id) must
        be active, and no role may grant a RoleAssignment to its own
        actor (ADR-020 item 6).
      tags: [governance-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  role_assignment_id,
                  actor_id,
                  role_code,
                  scope_id,
                  valid_from,
                  granter_role_assignment_id,
                ]
              properties:
                role_assignment_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                actor_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                role_code:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      governance_policy_proposer,
                      governance_policy_approver,
                      governance_reviewer,
                      technical_challenge_reviewer,
                      ballot_invalidation_proposer,
                      ballot_invalidation_approver,
                      oversight_reviewer,
                      observer,
                    ]
                scope_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                valid_from: { type: string, format: date-time }
                valid_until: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
                granter_role_assignment_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                approval_reference: { type: [string, "null"] }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Role assignment requested; governance.role_assignment_requested emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [assignment]
                properties:
                  assignment: { $ref: "../schemas/role-assignment.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: >-
            PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06), ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_ACTIVE — granter
            is not active, or SAME_ACTOR_APPROVAL_REJECTED — granter's actor
            equals the new assignment's actor.
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such granter_role_assignment_id.

  /role-assignments/{roleAssignmentId}/activate:
    post:
      operationId: activateRoleAssignment
      summary: pending -> active
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.activate_role_assignment.
      tags: [governance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: roleAssignmentId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Role assignment activated; governance.role_assignment_activated emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [assignment]
                properties:
                  assignment: { $ref: "../schemas/role-assignment.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06).
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such role_assignment_id.
        "422":
          description: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION (CT-00-03).

  /role-assignments/{roleAssignmentId}/revoke:
    post:
      operationId: revokeRoleAssignment
      summary: active|pending|suspended -> revoked
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.revoke_role_assignment.
      tags: [governance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: roleAssignmentId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Role assignment revoked; governance.role_assignment_revoked emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [assignment]
                properties:
                  assignment: { $ref: "../schemas/role-assignment.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06).
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such role_assignment_id.
        "422":
          description: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION (CT-00-03).

  /role-assignments/{roleAssignmentId}:
    get:
      operationId: getRoleAssignment
      summary: Plain, unaudited read of one RoleAssignment by id
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.get_role_assignment.
      tags: [governance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: roleAssignmentId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Role assignment found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "../schemas/role-assignment.schema.json" }
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such role_assignment_id.

  # ==========================================================================
  # governance-service — GovernancePolicy
  # ==========================================================================
  /governance-policies:
    post:
      operationId: proposeGovernancePolicy
      summary: Create a new GovernancePolicy in draft status
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.propose_governance_policy.
        version is assigned automatically as one more than the highest
        version ever created for policy_type. Both proposed_by_role_id
        and approved_by_role_id must already be active, in the correct
        role, and distinct actors (ADR-020 item 1) at proposal time.
      tags: [governance-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  governance_policy_id,
                  policy_type,
                  rule_definition,
                  effective_from,
                  proposed_by_role_id,
                  approved_by_role_id,
                ]
              properties:
                governance_policy_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                policy_type:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      role_taxonomy,
                      approval_rule,
                      challenge_rule,
                      oversight_rule,
                    ]
                rule_definition: { type: object }
                effective_from: { type: string, format: date-time }
                proposed_by_role_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                approved_by_role_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Governance policy proposed; governance.policy_proposed emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [policy]
                properties:
                  policy: { $ref: "../schemas/governance-policy.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: >-
            PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06), TWO_ACTOR_APPROVAL_REQUIRED,
            ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_ACTIVE, ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_SCOPE_MISMATCH, or
            SAME_ACTOR_APPROVAL_REJECTED.

  /governance-policies/{governancePolicyId}/activate:
    post:
      operationId: activateGovernancePolicy
      summary: draft -> active (may also supersede a prior active policy of the same type)
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.activate_governance_policy.
        Re-validates both proposed_by_role_id and approved_by_role_id are
        still active, in the correct role, in scope, and distinct
        actors. If another policy is already active for the same
        policy_type, this call also transitions it active -> superseded
        (canon 19b.2: at most one active version at a time) and emits
        governance.policy_superseded for it.
      tags: [governance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: governancePolicyId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: >-
            Governance policy activated; governance.policy_activated emitted
            (and governance.policy_superseded for the prior active policy of
            the same type, if any).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [policy]
                properties:
                  policy: { $ref: "../schemas/governance-policy.schema.json" }
                  superseded_policy:
                    oneOf:
                      - { $ref: "../schemas/governance-policy.schema.json" }
                      - type: "null"
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: >-
            PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06), TWO_ACTOR_APPROVAL_REQUIRED,
            ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_ACTIVE, ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_SCOPE_MISMATCH, or
            SAME_ACTOR_APPROVAL_REJECTED.
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such governance_policy_id.
        "422":
          description: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION (CT-00-03).

  # ==========================================================================
  # governance-service — GovernanceDecision
  # ==========================================================================
  /governance-decisions:
    post:
      operationId: proposeGovernanceDecision
      summary: Create a new GovernanceDecision in proposed status
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.propose_governance_decision.
        decision_type is a discriminator (minimum: ballot_invalidation,
        technical_challenge_adjudication, result_finality_determination,
        mandate, oversight_directive); subject_reference's shape depends
        on decision_type. For decision_type=result_finality_determination,
        canon 19b.5's "no finality while any challenge remains
        unresolved" and "exactly one current non-superseded
        determination" rules are checked here too (in addition to the
        authoritative check at approval time).
      tags: [governance-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  governance_decision_id,
                  decision_type,
                  subject_reference,
                  proposed_by_role_id,
                  reason_code,
                  evidence_references,
                ]
              properties:
                governance_decision_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                decision_type:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      ballot_invalidation,
                      technical_challenge_adjudication,
                      result_finality_determination,
                      mandate,
                      oversight_directive,
                    ]
                subject_reference: { type: object }
                proposed_by_role_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                reason_code: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                evidence_references:
                  type: array
                  items: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                supersedes_decision_id: { type: [string, "null"], format: uuid }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Governance decision proposed; governance.decision_proposed emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [decision]
                properties:
                  decision:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/governance-decision.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: >-
            PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06), ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_ACTIVE, or
            ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_SCOPE_MISMATCH.
        "409":
          description: >-
            RESULT_FINALITY_DETERMINATION_DUPLICATE — a non-superseded
            result_finality_determination already exists for this
            result_publication.
        "422":
          description: >-
            RESULT_FINALITY_BLOCKED_BY_OPEN_CHALLENGE — the referenced
            result_publication still has an unresolved technical challenge.

  /governance-decisions/{governanceDecisionId}/approve:
    post:
      operationId: approveGovernanceDecision
      summary: proposed -> approved
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.approve_governance_decision.
        Two-actor approval is required for every GovernanceDecision
        approval (ADR-020 item 1), which includes ballot invalidation and
        result-finality determination as named decision_type values. When
        decision_type=technical_challenge_adjudication, also transitions
        the linked TechnicalChallenge to upheld (canon 19b.4). When
        decision_type=result_finality_determination, requires
        finality_outcome and re-validates canon 19b.5's rules. When this
        decision's own supersedes_decision_id was set at proposal time,
        also emits governance.decision_superseded for the decision it
        supersedes.
      tags: [governance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: governanceDecisionId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [approved_by_role_id]
              properties:
                approved_by_role_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                finality_outcome:
                  type: [string, "null"]
                  enum: [final, invalidated, null]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: >-
            Governance decision approved; governance.decision_approved
            emitted (and governance.technical_challenge_adjudicated /
            governance.decision_superseded, as applicable).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [decision]
                properties:
                  decision:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/governance-decision.schema.json" }
                  superseded_decision:
                    oneOf:
                      - { $ref: "../schemas/governance-decision.schema.json" }
                      - type: "null"
                  challenge:
                    oneOf:
                      - { $ref: "../schemas/technical-challenge.schema.json" }
                      - type: "null"
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: >-
            PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06), TWO_ACTOR_APPROVAL_REQUIRED,
            ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_ACTIVE, ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_SCOPE_MISMATCH, or
            SAME_ACTOR_APPROVAL_REJECTED.
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such governance_decision_id.
        "409":
          description: >-
            RESULT_FINALITY_DETERMINATION_DUPLICATE (re-validated at
            approval time).
        "422":
          description: >-
            VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION (CT-00-03), or
            RESULT_FINALITY_BLOCKED_BY_OPEN_CHALLENGE (re-validated at
            approval time), or TECHNICAL_CHALLENGE_ALREADY_ADJUDICATED.

  /governance-decisions/{governanceDecisionId}/reject:
    post:
      operationId: rejectGovernanceDecision
      summary: proposed -> rejected
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.reject_governance_decision.
        Two-actor approval is required (ADR-020 item 1: proposer and
        rejecter must be distinct, both active and in scope). When
        decision_type=technical_challenge_adjudication, also transitions
        the linked TechnicalChallenge to rejected.
      tags: [governance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: governanceDecisionId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [rejected_by_role_id]
              properties:
                rejected_by_role_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: >-
            Governance decision rejected; governance.decision_rejected
            emitted (and governance.technical_challenge_adjudicated, if
            applicable).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [decision]
                properties:
                  decision:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/governance-decision.schema.json" }
                  challenge:
                    oneOf:
                      - { $ref: "../schemas/technical-challenge.schema.json" }
                      - type: "null"
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: >-
            PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06), TWO_ACTOR_APPROVAL_REQUIRED,
            ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_ACTIVE, ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_SCOPE_MISMATCH, or
            SAME_ACTOR_APPROVAL_REJECTED.
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such governance_decision_id.
        "422":
          description: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION (CT-00-03).

  /governance-decisions/{governanceDecisionId}:
    get:
      operationId: getGovernanceDecision
      summary: Plain, unaudited read of one GovernanceDecision by id
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.get_governance_decision. Added
        under ADR-017 as the one authorized way
        voting-service.invalidate_ballot may read a GovernanceDecision
        before invalidating its own Ballot (canon 19b.6) — the first
        reverse/bidirectional cross-pack read edge in this project.
      tags: [governance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: governanceDecisionId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Governance decision found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "../schemas/governance-decision.schema.json" }
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such governance_decision_id.

  /result-publications/{resultPublicationId}/finality-status:
    get:
      operationId: getFinalityStatus
      summary: Derived FinalityStatus read model for a ResultPublication
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.get_finality_status. Never a
        stored field of any entity (canon 19b.3/19b.6) — computed fresh
        from TechnicalChallenge state and the current, non-superseded
        result_finality_determination GovernanceDecision (if any) for
        this result_publication_id. ResultPublication itself is never
        written by this pack; this is the sole authoritative way to learn
        a result's finality.
      tags: [governance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: resultPublicationId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Finality status computed.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [finality_status]
                properties:
                  finality_status:
                    type: string
                    enum: [provisional, finality_blocked, final, invalidated]

  # ==========================================================================
  # governance-service — TechnicalChallenge
  # ==========================================================================
  /technical-challenges:
    post:
      operationId: submitTechnicalChallenge
      summary: Create a new TechnicalChallenge in submitted status
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.submit_technical_challenge.
        submitted_at (the command's own clock reading) must strictly
        precede the referenced ResultPublication.challenge_deadline_at
        (read via epd2_tally_service.application.get_result_publication,
        ADR-012/017). A role_assignment-type
        submitter_authorization_reference is validated locally (must
        resolve to an active, in-scope RoleAssignment); a
        participation_credential-type reference is accepted as an
        opaque, caller-supplied proof and never dereferenced (canon
        19b.4, mirroring PACK-04's publish_ledger_entry raw_content
        precedent).
      tags: [governance-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  technical_challenge_id,
                  result_publication_id,
                  submitter_authorization_type,
                  submitter_authorization_reference,
                  challenge_reason_code,
                  evidence_references,
                ]
              properties:
                technical_challenge_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                result_publication_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                submitter_authorization_type:
                  type: string
                  enum: [participation_credential, role_assignment]
                submitter_authorization_reference:
                  { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                challenge_reason_code: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                evidence_references:
                  type: array
                  items: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Technical challenge submitted; governance.technical_challenge_submitted emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [challenge]
                properties:
                  challenge:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/technical-challenge.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: >-
            PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06), or
            TECHNICAL_CHALLENGE_SUBMITTER_INELIGIBLE — submitter's
            RoleAssignment is not active/in-scope, or does not match
            ADR-020 item 2's eligibility criteria.
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such result_publication_id.
        "422":
          description: TECHNICAL_CHALLENGE_WINDOW_CLOSED — the challenge deadline has passed.

  /technical-challenges/{technicalChallengeId}/begin-review:
    post:
      operationId: beginTechnicalChallengeReview
      summary: submitted -> under_review
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.begin_technical_challenge_review.
        Deliberately emits no canonical event — canon section 20.15's
        twelve-event catalog names only
        governance.technical_challenge_submitted and
        governance.technical_challenge_adjudicated; this transition is
        audited (CT-00-07) but not represented as a domain event, since
        adding a thirteenth event not in canon 0.4.0 is out of this
        pack's scope.
      tags: [governance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: technicalChallengeId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Technical challenge review started; audited, no domain event.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [challenge]
                properties:
                  challenge:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/technical-challenge.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06).
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such technical_challenge_id.
        "422":
          description: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION (CT-00-03).

  /technical-challenges/{technicalChallengeId}:
    get:
      operationId: getTechnicalChallenge
      summary: Plain, unaudited read of one TechnicalChallenge by id
      description: >
        Owned by governance-service. Maps to
        epd2_governance_service.application.get_technical_challenge.
      tags: [governance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: technicalChallengeId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Technical challenge found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "../schemas/technical-challenge.schema.json" }
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — no such technical_challenge_id.

```


### FILE `EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/openapi/pack-06.yaml`

```text
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: EPD² Civic OS — CLAUDE-PACK-06 service contracts
  version: "0.1.0"
  description: >
    Transport-neutral API contract for the one PACK-06 service
    (ai-processing-service, ADR-021). No production HTTP server ships in
    this pack — these paths document, one-to-one, every real command
    function in epd2_ai_processing_service.application and are exercised
    in tests via those application-layer functions directly, not over
    HTTP. Request bodies list only genuine business fields — actor
    identity, authorization, correlation/causation ids, the clock, and
    the idempotency event_id are transport/session concerns, the same
    convention contracts/openapi/pack-02.yaml through pack-05.yaml
    already follow.

    Per canon 19c.3 and ADR-022, no path or schema in this file ever
    declares human_reviewer_reference as part of a *published event*
    payload — it is an internal field, present only in the stored
    AIProcessingRecord response body, never in
    contracts/events/ai-processing-record-payload.v1.schema.json.

    verify_role_assignment_for_action (governance-service, ADR-022) has
    no HTTP-shaped contract here at all — it is a narrow, internal,
    cross-pack read this pack's own commands call directly, documented
    in contracts/openapi/pack-05.yaml under the governance-service tag
    if at all, never invented as a PACK-06 endpoint.
externalDocs:
  description: Canonical domain model
  url: ../../docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md

servers:
  - url: https://ai-processing.epd2.example
    description: ai-processing-service (not deployed in PACK-06 — contract only)

paths:
  # ==========================================================================
  # ai-processing-service — AIProcessingRecord lifecycle
  # ==========================================================================
  /ai-processing-records:
    post:
      operationId: requestAiProcessing
      summary: Create a new AIProcessingRecord in requested status
      description: >
        Owned by ai-processing-service. Maps to
        epd2_ai_processing_service.application.request_ai_processing.
        purpose_code/target_type must be on this pack's own closed
        allow-lists (ADR-025 §2). human_review_status is decided once,
        here: pending if is_consequential, else not_required.
      tags: [ai-processing-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  ai_processing_record_id,
                  purpose_code,
                  target_type,
                  target_id,
                  input_version,
                  model_provider,
                  model_name,
                  model_version,
                  prompt_template_version,
                  is_consequential,
                ]
              properties:
                ai_processing_record_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                purpose_code:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      summarization,
                      classification,
                      recommendation,
                      drafting,
                      anomaly_indication,
                      policy_compliance_assistance,
                    ]
                target_type: { type: string }
                target_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                input_version: { type: string }
                model_provider: { type: string }
                model_name: { type: string }
                model_version: { type: string }
                prompt_template_version: { type: string }
                is_consequential: { type: boolean }
                disclosure_required: { type: boolean }
                external_provider_flag: { type: boolean }
                processing_region: { type: [string, "null"] }
                data_retention_mode: { type: [string, "null"] }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: AI processing requested; ai.processing_requested emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [record]
                properties:
                  record:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/ai-processing-record.schema.json" }
                  event: { $ref: "../schemas/event-envelope.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: PERMISSION_DENIED (CT-00-06).
        "422":
          description: AI_TARGET_REFERENCE_MALFORMED, AI_POLICY_CONFLICT — external-provider use not allowed for this use class/region/retention mode.

  /ai-processing-records/{aiProcessingRecordId}/prepare-input:
    post:
      operationId: prepareInput
      summary: requested -> input_prepared (or -> rejected_by_policy on redaction failure)
      description: >
        Owned by ai-processing-service. Maps to
        epd2_ai_processing_service.application.prepare_input.
        ai-processing-service performs redaction/provenance validation
        itself — a caller-supplied redaction_applied flag is never
        accepted (required scope item 6).
      tags: [ai-processing-service]
      parameters:
        - name: aiProcessingRecordId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [input_reference, declared_input_classification]
              properties:
                input_reference: { type: string }
                declared_input_classification: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Input prepared or rejected by policy; ai.input_prepared or ai.processing_rejected_by_policy emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  record:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/ai-processing-record.schema.json" }
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND.
        "422":
          description: AI_INPUT_PROVENANCE_UNVERIFIED, AI_REDACTION_MANIFEST_INVALID.

  /ai-processing-records/{aiProcessingRecordId}/begin-processing:
    post:
      operationId: beginProcessing
      summary: input_prepared -> processing (no canon event; audited only)
      description: >
        Owned by ai-processing-service. Maps to
        epd2_ai_processing_service.application.begin_processing.
      tags: [ai-processing-service]
      parameters:
        - name: aiProcessingRecordId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Processing begun.

  /ai-processing-records/{aiProcessingRecordId}/complete:
    post:
      operationId: completeProcessingWithProvider
      summary: processing -> completed, or -> failed on a provider error/low confidence
      description: >
        Owned by ai-processing-service. Maps to
        epd2_ai_processing_service.application.complete_processing_with_provider.
        The provider is never given any callback/tool/command interface
        capable of mutating Civic OS (required scope item 12).
      tags: [ai-processing-service]
      parameters:
        - name: aiProcessingRecordId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [prepared_input_reference, timeout_seconds]
              properties:
                prepared_input_reference: { type: string }
                timeout_seconds: { type: number }
                confidence_threshold: { type: number }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Completed or failed; ai.output_created or ai.processing_failed emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  record:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/ai-processing-record.schema.json" }
        "422":
          description: AI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, AI_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT, AI_OUTPUT_MALFORMED, AI_MODEL_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED, AI_CONFIDENCE_BELOW_THRESHOLD.

  /ai-processing-records/{aiProcessingRecordId}/review:
    post:
      operationId: reviewAiOutput
      summary: pending -> {approved | approved_with_changes | rejected}
      description: >
        Owned by ai-processing-service. Maps to
        epd2_ai_processing_service.application.review_ai_output.
        Reviewer authorization is always independently verified via
        governance-service.verify_role_assignment_for_action (ADR-022)
        — actor_is_authorized alone is never sufficient here.
      tags: [ai-processing-service]
      parameters:
        - name: aiProcessingRecordId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  reviewer_role_assignment_id,
                  reviewer_subject_scope_id,
                  requesting_actor_reference,
                  is_official_publication,
                  outcome,
                ]
              properties:
                reviewer_role_assignment_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                reviewer_subject_scope_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                requesting_actor_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
                is_official_publication: { type: boolean }
                outcome:
                  type: string
                  enum: [approved, approved_with_changes, rejected]
                corrected_output_reference: { type: [string, "null"] }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Reviewed; ai.output_accepted, ai.output_corrected, or ai.output_rejected emitted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  record:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/ai-processing-record.schema.json" }
        "403":
          description: AI_REVIEWER_ROLE_INVALID, AI_REVIEWER_SCOPE_MISMATCH, AI_REVIEW_SELF_APPROVAL_PROHIBITED.

  /ai-processing-records/{aiProcessingRecordId}/disclosure-package:
    post:
      operationId: createDisclosurePackage
      summary: Construct the immutable AIDisclosurePackage and record disclosure_package_reference
      description: >
        Owned by ai-processing-service. Maps to
        epd2_ai_processing_service.application.create_disclosure_package.
        Requires verified human approval first (19c.7 step 1-2).
      tags: [ai-processing-service]
      parameters:
        - name: aiProcessingRecordId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [approved_public_model_category]
              properties:
                approved_public_model_category: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Disclosure package created (never persisted); DisclosureStatus becomes pending_publication.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  package:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/ai-disclosure-package.schema.json" }
        "409":
          description: AI_CONSEQUENTIAL_OUTPUT_NOT_REVIEWED, AI_HUMAN_REVIEWER_MISSING, AI_OUTPUT_REJECTED_BY_HUMAN.

  /ai-processing-records/{aiProcessingRecordId}/disclosure-publish:
    post:
      operationId: publishAiDisclosure
      summary: Publish the disclosure package via transparency-service; record disclosure_receipt_reference
      description: >
        Owned by ai-processing-service. Maps to
        epd2_ai_processing_service.application.publish_ai_disclosure.
        Calls transparency-service.publish_ledger_entry directly —
        ai-processing-service never writes PublicLedgerEntry itself
        (19c.7 step 3-4).
      tags: [ai-processing-service]
      parameters:
        - name: aiProcessingRecordId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [published_by_role_id, subject_event_id]
              properties:
                published_by_role_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                subject_event_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Published; DisclosureStatus becomes published.
        "424":
          description: AI_PUBLIC_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED — publication failed (fail-closed; no receipt recorded).

  /ai-processing-records/{aiProcessingRecordId}:
    get:
      operationId: getAiProcessingRecord
      summary: Plain, unaudited read of one AIProcessingRecord
      description: >
        Owned by ai-processing-service. Maps to
        epd2_ai_processing_service.application.get_ai_processing_record.
      tags: [ai-processing-service]
      parameters:
        - name: aiProcessingRecordId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The record, if it exists.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  record:
                    { $ref: "../schemas/ai-processing-record.schema.json" }
        "404":
          description: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND.

```
