### FILE `EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/openapi/pack-08.yaml`

```text
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: EPD² Civic OS — CLAUDE-PACK-08 service contracts
  version: "0.1.0"
  description: >
    Transport-neutral API contract for the one PACK-08 service
    (organization-service, canon-0.7.0 section 19e; ADR-032 through
    ADR-037). No production HTTP server ships in this pack — these
    paths document, one-to-one, a deliberately minimal subset of real
    command/query functions in epd2_organization_service.application,
    and are exercised in tests via those application-layer functions
    directly, not over HTTP. Every path maps to exactly one real
    function; none of this file's paths invent an HTTP surface a
    function does not already provide.

    Per task section 19's own "minimal reference APIs only" instruction,
    this file documents exactly the nine operation shapes that section
    lists — create organization; read current/historical organization;
    create/end relation; query relationship graph; assign/revoke
    authority; check regional capability; list scoped authority
    assignments; read current/historical CivicSpace; inspect effective
    scope — and nothing beyond them. In particular, organization
    lifecycle-transition commands (activate/suspend/dissolve/merge/
    split/declare_successor) and OrganizationalUnit management exist in
    the application layer but are deliberately NOT exposed as their own
    HTTP paths in this minimal reference contract; a future
    implementation pack may add them, additively, under its own review.
    This mirrors PACK-05's own precedent of omitting its bootstrap-seed
    command from its OpenAPI contract by deliberate design, not
    oversight.

    Request bodies list only genuine business fields — actor identity,
    authorization, correlation/causation ids, the clock, and the
    idempotency event_id are transport/session concerns, the same
    convention every earlier pack's own OpenAPI contract already
    follows.

    Per task section 19's own rules: no bulk cross-regional directory
    endpoint and no public member directory exist in this file (there is
    no "list all organizations"/"list all authority holders across
    scopes" path at all); every authorization-consequential path is
    described as evaluated server-side, never trusting frontend input;
    checkRegionalCapability is the one atomic capability check this
    contract exposes, returning only the minimal
    RegionalScopeAccessDecision shape (canon 19e.12/section 22) — never
    any broader identity or membership data.
externalDocs:
  description: Canonical domain model
  url: ../../docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md

servers:
  - url: https://organization.epd2.example
    description: organization-service (not deployed in PACK-08 — contract only)

paths:
  # ==========================================================================
  # organization-service — Organization
  # ==========================================================================
  /organizations:
    post:
      operationId: createOrganization
      summary: Create a new Organization in draft status
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. Maps to
        epd2_organization_service.application.create_organization.
        Never activated automatically (canon 19e.10) — a separate,
        non-public activation step is required before the organization
        may issue authority or otherwise act as active.
      tags: [organization-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  organization_id,
                  name,
                  legal_operator,
                  organization_type,
                  organization_profile,
                  default_policy_version,
                  effective_from,
                  authorizing_decision_reference,
                ]
              properties:
                organization_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                name: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                legal_operator: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                organization_type: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                organization_profile:
                  type: string
                  description: >
                    Extensible without schema redesign (task section 5);
                    the known baseline values are bund, landesverband,
                    kreisverband, bezirksverband, ortsverband,
                    ortsgruppe, non_territorial_unit,
                    cross_regional_unit, special_unit.
                default_policy_version: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                effective_from: { type: string, format: date-time }
                authorizing_decision_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Organization created in draft status
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/organization.schema.json"
        "403":
          description: Actor not authorized (PERMISSION_DENIED)

  /organizations/{organization_id}:
    get:
      operationId: getOrganization
      summary: Read current or historical Organization state
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. Current state (as_of omitted) or
        historical/future-dated state (as_of supplied) — canon 19e.9's
        effective-dating rules: current state never overwrites
        historical truth; a historical query is always answerable.
        Returns HISTORICAL_SCOPE_NOT_EFFECTIVE if as_of falls outside
        every recorded version's [valid_from, valid_until) window.
      tags: [organization-service]
      parameters:
        - name: organization_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
        - name: as_of
          in: query
          required: false
          schema: { type: string, format: date-time }
          description: Evaluate state as of this time; omit for current state.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Organization state at the requested time
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/organization.schema.json"
        "404":
          description: Unknown organization_id (VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND)

  # ==========================================================================
  # organization-service — CivicSpace (canon 8.2, first real implementation)
  # ==========================================================================
  /civic-spaces/{space_id}:
    get:
      operationId: getCivicSpace
      summary: Read current or historical CivicSpace state
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. Mirrors getOrganization's
        current/historical as_of convention.
      tags: [organization-service]
      parameters:
        - name: space_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
        - name: as_of
          in: query
          required: false
          schema: { type: string, format: date-time }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: CivicSpace state at the requested time
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/civic-space.schema.json"
        "404":
          description: Unknown space_id (VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND)

  # ==========================================================================
  # organization-service — OrganizationalRelation (canon 19e.7)
  # ==========================================================================
  /organizational-relations:
    post:
      operationId: createOrganizationalRelation
      summary: Create a new typed OrganizationalRelation between two Organizations
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. Maps to
        epd2_organization_service.application.create_organizational_relation.
        Validated before saving: hierarchy-category cycle forbidden
        (ORGANIZATIONAL_CYCLE_FORBIDDEN), unpermitted hierarchy overlap
        forbidden (ORGANIZATIONAL_RELATION_OVERLAP), and, for
        temporary_supervision_by, a mandatory bounded window (max 90
        days by default, TEMPORARY_SUPERVISION_WINDOW_INVALID
        otherwise).
      tags: [organization-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  relation_id,
                  relation_type,
                  source_organization_id,
                  target_organization_id,
                  valid_from,
                ]
              properties:
                relation_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                relation_type:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      parent_of,
                      subordinate_to,
                      affiliated_with,
                      successor_of,
                      merged_into,
                      split_from,
                      temporary_supervision_by,
                      operates_within,
                      participates_in,
                    ]
                source_organization_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                target_organization_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                valid_from: { type: string, format: date-time }
                valid_until: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
                authorizing_decision_reference:
                  type: [string, "null"]
                  format: uuid
      responses:
        "201":
          description: OrganizationalRelation created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/organizational-relation.schema.json"
        "409":
          description: >
            Cycle forbidden, unpermitted overlap, or invalid temporary
            supervision window (ORGANIZATIONAL_CYCLE_FORBIDDEN /
            ORGANIZATIONAL_RELATION_OVERLAP /
            TEMPORARY_SUPERVISION_WINDOW_INVALID)

  /organizational-relations/{relation_id}/end:
    post:
      operationId: endOrganizationalRelation
      summary: End an active OrganizationalRelation
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. Maps to
        epd2_organization_service.application.end_organizational_relation.
        Sets valid_until and status=ended — never an in-place edit of any
        other field (canon 19e.9/19e.10); the ended record remains
        queryable historically.
      tags: [organization-service]
      parameters:
        - name: relation_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [valid_until]
              properties:
                valid_until: { type: string, format: date-time }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OrganizationalRelation ended
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/organizational-relation.schema.json"
        "404":
          description: Unknown relation_id (VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND)

  /organizational-relations/graph:
    get:
      operationId: queryRelationshipGraph
      summary: Query the currently-active typed relationship graph for one Organization
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. Maps to
        epd2_organization_service.storage.OrganizationalRelationStore
        .list_active_for_organization — every currently-active relation
        (any relation_type) where the given organization_id is either
        the source or the target. Multiple relation types between the
        same two Organizations are returned as separate rows, never
        merged. Never a bulk, unscoped, cross-regional directory query —
        always scoped to exactly one organization_id.
      tags: [organization-service]
      parameters:
        - name: organization_id
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
        - name: relation_type
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              [
                parent_of,
                subordinate_to,
                affiliated_with,
                successor_of,
                merged_into,
                split_from,
                temporary_supervision_by,
                operates_within,
                participates_in,
              ]
          description: Optionally narrow the result to one relation_type.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Every currently-active relation touching organization_id
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "../schemas/organizational-relation.schema.json"

  # ==========================================================================
  # organization-service — OrganizationalAuthority (canon 19e.15-19e.17)
  # ==========================================================================
  /organizational-authorities:
    post:
      operationId: assignOrganizationalAuthority
      summary: Assign a new OrganizationalAuthority
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. Maps to
        epd2_organization_service.application.assign_organizational_authority.
        Self-assignment forbidden
        (ORGANIZATION_SELF_ASSIGNMENT_FORBIDDEN); role-incompatibility
        baseline enforced (AUTHORITY_ROLE_INCOMPATIBLE); the appointing
        Organization must be active (ORGANIZATION_NOT_ACTIVE). Where
        require_dual_control is true, the created row starts in
        proposed status and requires a separate
        activateOrganizationalAuthority-shaped call (not itself exposed
        as its own path in this minimal contract) by a distinct actor
        before becoming active.
      tags: [organization-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  authority_id,
                  role_code,
                  scope_type,
                  scope_reference,
                  appointing_authority_reference,
                  assigned_subject_reference,
                  valid_from,
                  policy_version,
                  decision_reference,
                ]
              properties:
                authority_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                role_code: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                scope_type:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      organization_scope,
                      jurisdiction_scope,
                      civic_space_scope,
                      process_scope,
                    ]
                scope_reference: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                appointing_authority_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
                assigned_subject_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
                valid_from: { type: string, format: date-time }
                valid_until: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
                policy_version: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                decision_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
                grants_procedural_authority: { type: boolean, default: false }
                grants_data_access: { type: boolean, default: false }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: OrganizationalAuthority assigned (proposed or active)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/organizational-authority.schema.json"
        "409":
          description: >
            Self-assignment, incompatible role, or inactive appointing
            organization (ORGANIZATION_SELF_ASSIGNMENT_FORBIDDEN /
            AUTHORITY_ROLE_INCOMPATIBLE / ORGANIZATION_NOT_ACTIVE)

  /organizational-authorities/{authority_id}/revoke:
    post:
      operationId: revokeOrganizationalAuthority
      summary: Revoke an active or suspended OrganizationalAuthority
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. Maps to
        epd2_organization_service.application.revoke_organizational_authority.
        Requires a revocation_reason_reference.
      tags: [organization-service]
      parameters:
        - name: authority_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [revocation_reason_reference]
              properties:
                revocation_reason_reference: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OrganizationalAuthority revoked
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/organizational-authority.schema.json"
        "404":
          description: Unknown authority_id (VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND)

  /organizational-authorities/scoped:
    get:
      operationId: listScopedAuthorityAssignments
      summary: List active OrganizationalAuthority assignments for one scope
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. Maps to
        epd2_organization_service.storage.OrganizationalAuthorityStore
        .list_active_for_scope. Never a bulk cross-regional or
        cross-scope directory — always scoped to exactly one
        (scope_type, scope_reference) pair, evaluated at exactly one
        point in time.
      tags: [organization-service]
      parameters:
        - name: scope_type
          in: query
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              [
                organization_scope,
                jurisdiction_scope,
                civic_space_scope,
                process_scope,
              ]
        - name: scope_reference
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        - name: as_of
          in: query
          required: false
          schema: { type: string, format: date-time }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Every active OrganizationalAuthority in the given scope at as_of
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "../schemas/organizational-authority.schema.json"

  # ==========================================================================
  # organization-service — Regional scope authorization (canon 19e.12)
  # ==========================================================================
  /regional-scope-access-checks:
    post:
      operationId: checkRegionalCapability
      summary: Evaluate one atomic regional-scope-authorization question
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. Maps to
        epd2_organization_service.application.check_regional_scope_access
        — a single-purpose, side-effect-free, default-deny read
        implementing all six canon 19e.12 access modes (exact/ancestor/
        descendant-scope, delegated cross-scope, temporary supervision,
        institutional oversight without data access). Role names and
        hierarchy position are never, by themselves, proof of authority;
        this endpoint is the only sanctioned way any caller learns
        whether an actor_scope may perform action_code against
        target_scope. Response is the minimal RegionalScopeAccessDecision
        shape only (canon section 22) — never broader identity data.
      tags: [organization-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  actor_scope_type,
                  actor_scope_reference,
                  target_scope_type,
                  target_scope_reference,
                  action_code,
                ]
              properties:
                actor_scope_type:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      organization_scope,
                      jurisdiction_scope,
                      civic_space_scope,
                      process_scope,
                    ]
                actor_scope_reference: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                target_scope_type:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      organization_scope,
                      jurisdiction_scope,
                      civic_space_scope,
                      process_scope,
                    ]
                target_scope_reference: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                role_code: { type: [string, "null"] }
                action_code: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                access_kind:
                  type: string
                  enum: [data_access, procedural_oversight]
                  default: data_access
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Atomic, minimal regional-scope-access decision
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  [
                    allowed,
                    reason_code,
                    scope_type,
                    scope_reference,
                    policy_version,
                    effective_time,
                  ]
                properties:
                  allowed: { type: boolean }
                  reason_code: { type: string }
                  scope_type:
                    type: string
                    enum:
                      [
                        organization_scope,
                        jurisdiction_scope,
                        civic_space_scope,
                        process_scope,
                      ]
                  scope_reference: { type: string }
                  policy_version: { type: [string, "null"] }
                  effective_time: { type: string, format: date-time }
                  mode:
                    type: [string, "null"]
                    enum:
                      [
                        exact_scope,
                        ancestor_scope,
                        descendant_scope,
                        delegated_cross_scope,
                        temporary_supervision,
                        institutional_oversight_without_data_access,
                        null,
                      ]
                  audit_reference: { type: [string, "null"], format: uuid }

  /organizational-scopes/effective:
    get:
      operationId: inspectEffectiveScope
      summary: Inspect the effective OrganizationalScope for one reference at one time
      description: >
        Owned by organization-service. A narrow, read-only inspection
        endpoint (task section 19's own "inspect effective scope" item) —
        resolves whether an OrganizationalScope reference is currently
        effective and, if applicable, which OrganizationalInheritancePolicy
        (canon 19e.13) governs it. Never itself an authorization decision
        — checkRegionalCapability is the only endpoint that makes one.
      tags: [organization-service]
      parameters:
        - name: scope_type
          in: query
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              [
                organization_scope,
                jurisdiction_scope,
                civic_space_scope,
                process_scope,
              ]
        - name: scope_reference
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        - name: as_of
          in: query
          required: false
          schema: { type: string, format: date-time }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Whether the scope reference is effective at as_of, and the governing policy_version if any
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: false
                required: [scope_type, scope_reference, effective]
                properties:
                  scope_type:
                    type: string
                    enum:
                      [
                        organization_scope,
                        jurisdiction_scope,
                        civic_space_scope,
                        process_scope,
                      ]
                  scope_reference: { type: string }
                  effective: { type: boolean }
                  policy_version: { type: [string, "null"] }
        "409":
          description: Requested time falls outside every recorded effective window (HISTORICAL_SCOPE_NOT_EFFECTIVE)
```

### FILE `EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/README.md`

```text
# Reason Codes

`pack-02.yml` in this directory is the executable, centralized reason-code
registry required by `CLAUDE-PACK-02` section 10. It is loaded at runtime
by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry.load_from_yaml`.

## Contents

- All 22 canon codes from `docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md`,
  section 24 (`source: canon`), copied verbatim — their meaning is fixed
  by canon and can only change via a canon ADR and version bump.
- 16 additive codes introduced by this pack (`source: pack-02-adr-004`),
  documented and justified in
  `docs/adr/ADR-004-reason-code-registry.md` — generic validation-layer
  codes reused across services, audit-integrity codes, credential-specific
  validation failures, and `AuditEvent.reason_code` classifications for
  successfully-audited actions (canon's section-24 list is refusal-only
  and has no code that means "this succeeded").

## Rules

- No service may use a free-text string in place of a registered code
  (canon section 24). Every `reason_code`/`reason_codes` literal in
  `services/*/src` must appear in `pack-02.yml` — enforced by
  `tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`.
- New reason codes require an ADR (see ADR-004 for the precedent) and are
  additive only: no entry's `code` or `meaning` may be repurposed once
  merged.
- `introduced_in_version` is `"0.1.0"` for canon-defined codes and
  `"pack-02-0.1.0"` for pack-introduced codes.

## Status

Executable (previously documentary-only in PACK-01). Loaded and validated
by `epd2_core.reason_codes`. The PACK-02 services' `exceptions.py` /
`validation.py` modules reference these codes by string literal rather
than importing the registry at raise-time, since `epd2_core.reason_codes`
requires PyYAML, which the domain services' own `pyproject.toml` files do
not declare as a dependency (services intentionally have no direct
dependency on YAML parsing). Consistency between every literal actually
used and this registry is verified structurally by
`tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`.

```

```text
# Centralized PACK-02 reason-code registry (pack section 10).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal used anywhere in `services/*/src` and `packages/python/epd2-core`.
# No service may use a free-text string in place of a registered code
# (canon section 24: "reason code не заменяется свободным текстом").
#
# `source: canon` entries are copied verbatim from
# `docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md`, section 24, canon version
# 0.1.0 - their meaning must never be changed here without a canon ADR and
# version bump. `source: pack-02-adr-004` entries are additive codes
# introduced by this pack, documented and justified in
# `docs/adr/ADR-004-reason-code-registry.md`; they are backward-compatible
# additions (canon section 25's "Minor" category) and change no existing
# canon code's meaning. See ADR-004 for the full rationale, including a
# real mislabeling bug (three exceptions that reused an unrelated canon
# code for a plain lookup-miss) found and fixed while assembling this
# registry.
#
# Loaded at runtime by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry`.
# Validated structurally against `epd2_core.minimal_json_schema` in
# `tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py` (Task 20), which also
# scans all five services' source for `reason_code`/`reason_codes`
# literals and asserts every one is registered here.

# --- Canon section 24 codes (verbatim list, source: canon 0.1.0) ---

- code: IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED
  meaning: >-
    A downstream check (eligibility evaluation, credential issuance)
    requires a verified IdentityRecord, but the referenced identity has not
    passed verification.
  severity: error
  description: Your identity has not been verified yet, so this action cannot proceed.
  retryable: true
  owner: Identity Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED
  meaning: >-
    An IdentityRecord's verification has expired (naturally, or via an
    explicit revocation mapped onto this event per ADR-002) and can no
    longer be relied on by downstream contexts.
  severity: error
  description: Your identity verification has expired and needs to be renewed.
  retryable: true
  owner: Identity Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: ELIGIBILITY_NOT_MET
  meaning: >-
    An EligibilityDecision was evaluated against a rule that exists, and
    the subject's claims did not satisfy the rule's requirements.
  severity: error
  description: You do not currently meet the eligibility requirements for this action.
  retryable: false
  owner: Eligibility Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: ELIGIBILITY_PENDING
  meaning: >-
    An EligibilityDecision could not be determined automatically (required
    claims were missing or incomplete) and requires manual review.
  severity: warning
  description: Your eligibility is pending manual review.
  retryable: true
  owner: Eligibility Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED
  meaning: A ParticipationCredential was presented for validation after its expires_at.
  severity: error
  description: This credential has expired.
  retryable: false
  owner: Credential Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: CREDENTIAL_ALREADY_USED
  meaning: >-
    A single-use (or usage-limited) ParticipationCredential was presented
    again after its usage_limit was already reached.
  severity: error
  description: This credential has already been used.
  retryable: false
  owner: Credential Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: CREDENTIAL_SCOPE_MISMATCH
  meaning: >-
    A ParticipationCredential was presented for a scope_type/scope_id that
    does not match the scope it was actually issued for.
  severity: error
  description: This credential is not valid for the requested scope.
  retryable: false
  owner: Credential Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: PERMISSION_DENIED
  meaning: >-
    The requesting actor is not authorized to perform the requested
    command, in any bounded context.
  severity: error
  description: You do not have permission to perform this action.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (all bounded contexts)
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: ROLE_CONFLICT
  meaning: An actor's assigned roles conflict in a way that forbids the requested action.
  severity: error
  description: Your current roles conflict and prevent this action.
  retryable: false
  owner: Organization Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: BALLOT_NOT_OPEN
  meaning: An action was attempted against a Ballot that is not currently open for voting.
  severity: error
  description: This ballot is not currently open.
  retryable: true
  owner: Voting Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: BALLOT_ALREADY_CLOSED
  meaning: An action was attempted against a Ballot that has already closed.
  severity: error
  description: This ballot has already closed.
  retryable: false
  owner: Voting Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: BALLOT_CONFIGURATION_LOCKED
  meaning: >-
    A change was attempted to a Ballot's configuration after it opened
    (canon INV-06 / CT-00-10 rule freeze).
  severity: error
  description: This ballot's configuration is locked and can no longer be changed.
  retryable: false
  owner: Voting Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: DUPLICATE_SUPPORT
  meaning: The same subject attempted to support the same initiative more than once.
  severity: error
  description: You have already supported this initiative.
  retryable: false
  owner: Initiative Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: DUPLICATE_VOTE
  meaning: The same subject attempted to cast a vote on the same ballot more than once.
  severity: error
  description: You have already voted on this ballot.
  retryable: false
  owner: Voting Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: DELEGATION_CYCLE
  meaning: The requested delegation would create a cycle in the delegation graph.
  severity: error
  description: This delegation would create a circular chain and cannot be created.
  retryable: false
  owner: Delegation Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: DELEGATION_EXPIRED
  meaning: A Delegation was presented or relied upon after its validity period ended.
  severity: error
  description: This delegation has expired.
  retryable: true
  owner: Delegation Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: MODERATION_POLICY_VIOLATION
  meaning: Content or an action violated a moderation policy.
  severity: error
  description: This violates the applicable moderation policy.
  retryable: false
  owner: Moderation Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: APPEAL_DEADLINE_EXPIRED
  meaning: An Appeal was submitted after its allowed deadline.
  severity: error
  description: The deadline to appeal this decision has passed.
  retryable: false
  owner: Moderation Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: EVENT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED
  meaning: >-
    An event or credential carried a major version this reader/validator
    does not support.
  severity: error
  description: This request uses a version that is no longer supported.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (event envelope, all bounded contexts)
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: INTEGRITY_CHECK_FAILED
  meaning: >-
    A structural or cryptographic integrity check failed (payload hash
    mismatch, signature mismatch, or equivalent).
  severity: critical
  description: An integrity check failed for this request.
  retryable: false
  owner: Audit Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: SERVICE_STATE_READ_ONLY
  meaning: The service (or a subsystem of it) is temporarily in a read-only state.
  severity: warning
  description: This service is temporarily read-only; please try again later.
  retryable: true
  owner: Governance Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: EMERGENCY_FREEZE_ACTIVE
  meaning: An EmergencyAction freeze is active and forbids the requested operation (CT-00-12).
  severity: critical
  description: An emergency freeze is currently active; this action is temporarily unavailable.
  retryable: true
  owner: Governance Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

# --- PACK-02 additive codes (source: pack-02-adr-004, see ADR-004) ---

- code: VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS
  meaning: >-
    A status/verification-status/decision-value string outside the
    entity's defined enum was supplied (CT-00-02).
  severity: error
  description: The status value provided is not recognized.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (account-service, identity-service, eligibility-service, credential-service)
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION
  meaning: >-
    The requested status transition is not present in the entity's
    allowed-transition table (CT-00-03).
  severity: error
  description: This status change is not allowed from the entity's current status.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (account-service, identity-service, credential-service)
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND
  meaning: >-
    No entity exists for the given identifier (a plain lookup miss),
    distinct from any business-rule refusal on a record that does exist.
    Introduced by ADR-004 to replace three exceptions that had mistakenly
    reused IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED, ELIGIBILITY_NOT_MET, and the
    non-existent CREDENTIAL_UNKNOWN_STATUS for this same lookup-miss case.
  severity: error
  description: No record was found for the given identifier.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (identity-service, eligibility-service, credential-service)
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: AUDIT_EVENT_CONFLICT
  meaning: >-
    An audit-event append request reused an existing audit_event_id with
    different caller-controlled content (pack section 9.3, CT-00-04
    analogue for the audit log).
  severity: critical
  description: This audit event conflicts with a previously recorded event of the same ID.
  retryable: false
  owner: audit-core
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: AUDIT_CHAIN_BROKEN
  meaning: >-
    Hash-chain verification detected a mismatch between a stored event's
    recomputed hash and its recorded hash, or a broken previous_hash link
    (pack section 9.2, INV-05).
  severity: critical
  description: The audit log's integrity chain is broken.
  retryable: false
  owner: audit-core
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_DUPLICATE_ISSUANCE_CONFLICT
  meaning: >-
    A repeated issuance request reused an existing credential_id with
    different content (CT-00-04 analogue for credential issuance).
  severity: error
  description: A credential with this identifier already exists with different content.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_REVOKED
  meaning: A ParticipationCredential was presented for validation after being revoked.
  severity: error
  description: This credential has been revoked.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_RULE_VERSION_MISMATCH
  meaning: >-
    A ParticipationCredential's rule_version does not match the
    rule_version expected by the validating caller.
  severity: error
  description: This credential was issued against a different rule version than expected.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_DIGEST_MISMATCH
  meaning: >-
    A ParticipationCredential's eligibility_snapshot_digest does not match
    the digest expected by the validating caller.
  severity: error
  description: This credential's eligibility snapshot digest does not match.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING
  meaning: >-
    A ParticipationCredential is missing a field required for validation
    (e.g. an empty eligibility_snapshot_digest).
  severity: error
  description: This credential is missing a field required for validation.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: ELIGIBILITY_RULE_VERSION_FROZEN
  meaning: >-
    A caller attempted to re-submit an existing
    (eligibility_rule_id, rule_version) pair with different content
    (canon section 9.1 rule-freeze requirement).
  severity: error
  description: This rule version is frozen and cannot be changed.
  retryable: false
  owner: eligibility-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_ISSUED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for a successfully issued
    ParticipationCredential (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal occurred).
  severity: info
  description: A participation credential was issued.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: IDENTITY_VERIFIED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for a successful identity
    verification (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal occurred).
  severity: info
  description: An identity was successfully verified.
  retryable: false
  owner: identity-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_STARTED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for the creation of a new
    IdentityRecord in pending status (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal
    occurred).
  severity: info
  description: An identity verification process was started.
  retryable: false
  owner: identity-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REVOKED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an explicit administrative
    revocation of a verified IdentityRecord, distinct from a
    system-detected natural expiry. Both map to the same canonical
    `identity.verification_expired` event per ADR-002 (canon defines no
    separate revocation event), but the audit trail's reason_code
    preserves the distinction the event name cannot.
  severity: warning
  description: An identity verification was explicitly revoked.
  retryable: true
  owner: identity-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: IDENTITY_DUPLICATE_SUSPECTED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an IdentityRecord
    transitioning to duplicate_suspected (a possible duplicate identity
    was detected during verification).
  severity: warning
  description: A possible duplicate identity was detected.
  retryable: true
  owner: identity-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: IDENTITY_MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an IdentityRecord
    transitioning to manual_review_required.
  severity: warning
  description: This identity verification requires manual review.
  retryable: true
  owner: identity-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: ELIGIBILITY_MET
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an eligibility decision that
    resulted in ELIGIBLE (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal occurred).
  severity: info
  description: An eligibility decision resulted in a positive determination.
  retryable: false
  owner: eligibility-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: ELIGIBILITY_SNAPSHOT_CREATED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for the creation of an
    EligibilitySnapshot (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal occurred).
  severity: info
  description: An eligibility snapshot was created.
  retryable: false
  owner: eligibility-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: ACCOUNT_CREATED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for the creation of a new

  severity: info
  description: An account was created.
  retryable: false

- code: ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGED

  retryable: false
  owner: account-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004
```

### FILE `EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/pack-03.yml`

```text
# Centralized PACK-03 reason-code registry (ADR-006).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal used anywhere in the six PACK-03 services'
# (initiative-service, deliberation-service, moderation-service,
# voting-service, tally-service, delegation-service) `src/`. No PACK-03
# service may use a free-text string in place of a registered code
# (canon section 24: "reason code \u043d\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u043c\u0435\u043d\u044f\u0435\u0442\u0441\u044f \u0441\u0432\u043e\u0431\u043e\u0434\u043d\u044b\u043c \u0442\u0435\u043a\u0441\u0442\u043e\u043c").
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# (ADR-006, Option B - see docs/adr/ADR-006-pack-03-reason-code-additions.md):
# PACK-02's five services and PACK-03's six services each have their own
# reason-code registry; codes that both need (e.g. PERMISSION_DENIED,
# VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS) are independently redeclared here rather than
# imported from pack-02.yml, so each pack's registry remains a complete,
# standalone source of truth for its own services.
#
# `source: canon` entries are the nine PACK-03-relevant canon section-24
# codes plus five reused shared/generic canon codes, all copied verbatim
# from docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md section 24, canon
# version 0.2.0 - their meaning must never be changed here without a canon
# ADR and version bump. `source: pack-03-adr-006` entries are additive
# codes introduced by this pack, documented and justified in
# docs/adr/ADR-006-pack-03-reason-code-additions.md; they are
# backward-compatible additions (canon section 25's "Minor" category) and
# change no existing canon code's meaning.
#
# Loaded at runtime by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry`.
# Validated structurally and scanned for every `reason_code` literal used
# in the six PACK-03 services by `tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`.

- code: BALLOT_NOT_OPEN
  meaning: An action was attempted against a Ballot that is not currently open for voting.
  severity: error
  description: This ballot is not currently open.
  retryable: true
  owner: Voting Context (voting-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: BALLOT_ALREADY_CLOSED
  meaning: An action was attempted against a Ballot that has already closed.
  severity: error
  description: This ballot has already closed.
  retryable: false
  owner: Voting Context (voting-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: BALLOT_CONFIGURATION_LOCKED
  meaning:
    A change was attempted to a Ballot's configuration after it opened (canon INV-06
    / CT-00-10 rule freeze).
  severity: error
  description: This ballot's configuration is locked and can no longer be changed.
  retryable: false
  owner: Voting Context (voting-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: DUPLICATE_SUPPORT
  meaning: The same subject attempted to support the same initiative more than once.
  severity: error
  description: You have already supported this initiative.
  retryable: false
  owner: Initiative Context (initiative-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: DUPLICATE_VOTE
  meaning:
    The same subject attempted to cast a vote on the same ballot more than once after
    the ballot closed (a legitimate pre-close vote change is handled via supersession, not
    this code).
  severity: error
  description: You have already voted on this ballot.
  retryable: false
  owner: Voting Context (voting-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: DELEGATION_CYCLE
  meaning:
    The requested delegation would create a cycle in the delegation graph (in this
    pilot's depth-1 cap, this includes any attempt to re-delegate).
  severity: error
  description: This delegation would create a circular chain and cannot be created.
  retryable: false
  owner: Delegation Context (delegation-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: DELEGATION_EXPIRED
  meaning: A Delegation was presented or relied upon after its validity period ended.
  severity: error
  description: This delegation has expired.
  retryable: true
  owner: Delegation Context (delegation-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: MODERATION_POLICY_VIOLATION
  meaning: Content or an action violated a moderation policy.
  severity: error
  description: This violates the applicable moderation policy.
  retryable: false
  owner: Moderation Context (moderation-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: APPEAL_DEADLINE_EXPIRED
  meaning:
    "An Appeal was submitted after its allowed deadline. Reserved in PACK-03: canon
    names this code but gives no deadline field in sections 14.2/14.3, so moderation-service
    does not currently raise it."
  severity: error
  description: The deadline to appeal this decision has passed.
  retryable: false
  owner: Moderation Context (moderation-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: PERMISSION_DENIED
  meaning:
    The requesting actor is not authorized to perform the requested command, in any
    bounded context.
  severity: error
  description: You do not have permission to perform this action.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (all six PACK-03 services)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: EVENT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED
  meaning: An event or credential carried a major version this reader/validator does not support.
  severity: error
  description: This request uses a version that is no longer supported.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (event envelope, all six PACK-03 services)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: INTEGRITY_CHECK_FAILED
  meaning:
    A structural or cryptographic integrity check failed (payload hash mismatch, signature
    mismatch, tally verification failure, or equivalent).
  severity: critical
  description: An integrity check failed for this request.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (tally-service verification, voting-service vote integrity)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: SERVICE_STATE_READ_ONLY
  meaning:
    "The service (or a subsystem of it) is temporarily in a read-only state. Reserved:
    no PACK-03 service currently triggers this condition."
  severity: warning
  description: This service is temporarily read-only; please try again later.
  retryable: true
  owner: Governance Context (reserved, out of PACK-03 scope)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: EMERGENCY_FREEZE_ACTIVE
  meaning:
    "An EmergencyAction freeze is active and forbids the requested operation (CT-00-12).
    Reserved: no PACK-03 service currently triggers this condition (EmergencyAction is out
    of this pack's scope)."
  severity: critical
  description: An emergency freeze is currently active; this action is temporarily unavailable.
  retryable: true
  owner: Governance Context (reserved, out of PACK-03 scope)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS
  meaning:
    A status/verification-status/decision-value string outside the entity's defined
    enum was supplied (CT-00-02). Mirrors pack-02-adr-004's additive code of the same name,
    redeclared here per ADR-006 since pack-03.yml is its own registry file.
  severity: error
  description: The status value provided is not recognized.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (all six PACK-03 services)
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION
  meaning:
    The requested status transition is not present in the entity's allowed-transition
    table (CT-00-03). Mirrors pack-02-adr-004's additive code of the same name.
  severity: error
  description: This status change is not allowed from the entity's current status.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (all six PACK-03 services)
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND
  meaning:
    No entity exists for the given identifier (a plain lookup miss), distinct from
    any business-rule refusal on a record that does exist. Mirrors pack-02-adr-004's additive
    code of the same name.
  severity: error
  description: No record was found for the given identifier.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (all six PACK-03 services)
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: INITIATIVE_VERSION_FROZEN
  meaning:
    A caller attempted to re-submit an existing (initiative_id, version_number) pair
    with different content - a published InitiativeVersion never changes (canon section 11.2).
  severity: error
  description: This initiative version is frozen and cannot be changed.
  retryable: false
  owner: initiative-service
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: AMENDMENT_TARGET_SUPERSEDED
  meaning:
    An Amendment's target_version_id no longer exists / was superseded before a decision
    was reached.
  severity: error
  description: This amendment's target version has been superseded.
  retryable: false
  owner: initiative-service
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: INITIATIVE_HAS_NO_VERSION
  meaning: An Initiative was submitted with no InitiativeVersion yet created for it.
  severity: error
  description: This initiative has no content version to submit.
  retryable: true
  owner: initiative-service
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: INITIATIVE_NOT_ACCEPTING_SUPPORT
  meaning:
    A SupportRecord was attempted against an Initiative not currently in support_collection
    status.
  severity: error
  description: This initiative is not currently accepting support.
  retryable: true
  owner: initiative-service
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: INITIATIVE_DUPLICATE_CREATION_CONFLICT
  meaning:
    A repeated Initiative creation request reused an existing initiative_id with different
    content (CT-00-04 analogue).
  severity: error
  description: An initiative with this identifier already exists with different content.
  retryable: false
  owner: initiative-service
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: SUPPORT_RECORD_DUPLICATE_CREATION_CONFLICT

    A repeated SupportRecord creation request reused an existing support_record_id

  severity: error
  description: A support record with this identifier already exists with different content.
  retryable: false
  owner: initiative-service
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: AMENDMENT_DUPLICATE_CREATION_CONFLICT
  meaning:
    A repeated Amendment creation request reused an existing amendment_id with different

  severity: error
  description: An amendment with this identifier already exists with different content.

- code: SOURCE_RECORD_DUPLICATE_CREATION_CONFLICT

  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: INITIATIVE_STATUS_CHANGED
  meaning:
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an Initiative status transition that
    reaches a canonical event (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal occurred).
  severity: info
  description: An initiative's status was changed.
  retryable: false
  owner: initiative-service
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: INITIATIVE_VERSION_CREATED

  severity: info

  source: pack-03-adr-006

  severity: info

  retryable: false

- code: SUPPORT_INVALIDATED

  retryable: false

  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: AMENDMENT_STATUS_CHANGED

    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an Amendment status transition that reaches

  severity: info

  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: DISCUSSION_DUPLICATE_CREATION_CONFLICT

  severity: info

  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: CONTRIBUTION_CREATED
  meaning: AuditEvent.reason_code classification for the creation of a new Contribution.

  description: A contribution was created.
  retryable: false

  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0

- code: CONTRIBUTION_EDITED

  severity: info

  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0

- code: CONTRIBUTION_FLAGGED

- code: CONTRIBUTION_STATUS_CHANGED

  severity: info
  description: A contribution's visibility status was changed.

  owner: deliberation-service
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: MODERATION_CASE_DUPLICATE_CONFLICT

  severity: error

  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: MODERATION_DECISION_ENFORCED

  severity: error

  retryable: false
  owner: voting-service
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0

  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
  source: pack-03-adr-006
- code: VOTE_ENVELOPE_NOT_RECEIPT_ELIGIBLE
  meaning:

  severity: error
  description: This vote is not eligible for a receipt.
  retryable: false
  owner: voting-service
  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0

  introduced_in_version: pack-03-0.1.0
```

```text
# duplicate-conflict code, not named by ADR-024 itself but following the
# same additive pattern ADR-006/ADR-014/ADR-019/ADR-024 already
# established for every other pack's own services.

# Note on cross-pack reason-code interaction (ADR-022's own amendment):
# AI_REVIEWER_ROLE_INVALID and AI_REVIEWER_SCOPE_MISMATCH are the only
# codes ai-processing-service itself ever *raises* upon receiving
# authorized: false from governance-service's verify_role_assignment_for_
# action read - this pack never raises governance-service's own pack-05
# codes. review_ai_output does, however, read (never raise)
# verification.reason_code == "ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_SCOPE_MISMATCH" as a
# control-flow discriminator (choosing AIReviewerScopeMismatchError over
# the more generic AIReviewerRoleInvalidError), so that literal is
# registered below too - purely for this file's own completeness/
# documentation purpose (ADR-004), duplicated from governance-service's
# own pack-05.yml entry exactly as PERMISSION_DENIED already is.
#
# Loaded at runtime by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry`.
# Validated structurally and scanned for every `reason_code` literal used
# in ai-processing-service by `tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`.
```

```text
# Centralized PACK-07 reason-code registry (canon-0.6.0's own 19d.15 list,
# ADR-026 through ADR-031).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal introduced by the PACK-07 implementation round: the NEW codes
# `eligibility-service`/`identity-service` (both pre-existing PACK-02
# services, extended in place rather than replaced) gained, plus every
# code `membership-service` (PACK-07's one wholly new service) uses.
# No PACK-07 code path may use a free-text string in place of a
# registered code (canon section 24).
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# through pack-06.yml (ADR-006 Option B precedent, extended by ADR-014,
# ADR-019, ADR-024, and now this implementation round): codes that
# multiple packs need (e.g. PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS,
# IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED) are independently redeclared here rather than
# imported from an earlier pack's file, so this file remains a complete,
# standalone source of truth for membership-service's own scan
# (`tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s `PACK07_SERVICE_DIRS`).
#
# `eligibility-service` and `identity-service` are the one exception to
# "each pack owns a disjoint set of services": both are PACK-02 services
# that also gained PACK-07 additive functions in this implementation
# round. Their own source is checked against the UNION of this file and
# pack-02.yml (never this file alone) - see
# `test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s `PACK07_SHARED_WITH_PACK02_SERVICE_DIRS`
# and its `_EXTRA_REGISTRIES_FOR_LITERAL_CHECK` mapping.
#
# `source: canon-19d15` entries are canon 19d.15's own explicitly-approved
# reason-code list (task 15 of the PACK-07 implementation scope), copied
# verbatim. `source: pack-07-service` entries are additive codes this
# implementation round introduced for its own audit/event bookkeeping
# (activation confirmations, submission/decision markers), following the
# same additive pattern ADR-004/ADR-014/ADR-019/ADR-024 already
# established. `source: pack-02-reused` entries are generic, pre-existing
# PACK-02 codes reused verbatim by membership-service (and, in
# eligibility-service's/identity-service's own case, already covered by
# pack-02.yml directly - duplicated here only so this file stays a
# complete, standalone reference for membership-service's own scan).
#
# Loaded at runtime by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry`.

# --- Canon 19d.15's four separated-eligibility-claim codes ---------------
```

```text
# Centralized PACK-08 reason-code registry (canon-0.7.0 section 19e /
# section 24's own 10-code list, ADR-032 through ADR-037).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal introduced by the PACK-08 implementation round: the 10 codes
# canon section 24 itself names for the Organization & Regional Scope
# domain, plus the narrowly-necessary additive codes
# `organization-service` (PACK-08's one wholly new service) uses for its
# own audit/event bookkeeping (creation/activation/status-change
# confirmations, relation/authority lifecycle markers), following the
# same additive pattern ADR-004/ADR-014/ADR-019/ADR-024/pack-07's own
# registry already established. No PACK-08 code path may use a free-text
# string in place of a registered code (canon section 24).
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# through pack-07.yml (ADR-006 Option B precedent): codes that multiple
# packs need (e.g. PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS,
# VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION, VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND) are
# independently redeclared here rather than imported from an earlier
# pack's file, so this file remains a complete, standalone source of

# unlike PACK-07's file there is no "shared with an earlier pack's
# service directory" union needed for the literal-usage check.
#
# `source: canon-24` entries are canon section 24's own explicitly-named
# 10-code list for the Organization & Regional Scope domain (task item 18
# of the PACK-08 implementation scope), copied verbatim. `source:
# pack-08-service` entries are additive codes this implementation round
# introduced for its own audit/event bookkeeping (organization lifecycle
# confirmations, relation/authority lifecycle markers, dual-control/
# temporary-supervision guards), following the same additive pattern

# --- Canon section 24's ten Organization & Regional Scope codes ----------

- code: ORGANIZATION_NOT_ACTIVE
  meaning: >-
    The referenced Organization is not currently in an active status
    (canon 8.1) - a draft, restricted, or archived organization cannot
    issue new organizational authority or otherwise act as an active
    party to the requested operation.
  severity: error
  description: This organization is not currently active.

  owner: organization-service

  source: canon-24

- code: ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH
  meaning: >-

    required for the requested operation (scope_type and/or

  severity: error
  description: The organizational scope provided does not match what is required for this action.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: CROSS_SCOPE_ACCESS_DENIED
  meaning: >-
    A regional-scope-authorization check (canon 19e.12) evaluated all six
    access modes (exact/ancestor/descendant/delegated-cross-scope/
    temporary-supervision/institutional-oversight-without-data-access)
    and found no grant covering the requested (actor_scope, target_scope,
    action_code) triple - the engine's default is deny.
  severity: error
  description: You are not authorized to access this organizational scope.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

  meaning: >-

  severity: error
  description: This authority assignment is not valid.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: AUTHORITY_ROLE_INCOMPATIBLE
  meaning: >-
    The candidate role_code conflicts with an existing active role_code
    already held by the same assigned_subject_reference in the same
    OrganizationalScope, per the role incompatibility baseline (canon
    19e.16, PAIRWISE_INCOMPATIBLE_ROLES).
  severity: error
  description: This role cannot be combined with a role you already hold in this scope.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: AUTHORITY_SCOPE_INVALID
  meaning: >-

  severity: error

  retryable: false

  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: SUCCESSOR_TRANSFER_REQUIRES_DECISION
  meaning: >-
    Canon 19e.10's hard invariant: a merge/split/successor relation alone
    never automatically transfers role, authority, access, or entitlement
    - any such transfer requires its own, explicit, distinct governed
    decision reference, separate from the reorganization's own decision.

  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: ORGANIZATIONAL_RELATION_OVERLAP
  meaning: >-
    A new hierarchy-category relation's [valid_from, valid_until) window
    overlaps an existing active relation asserting a different parent for
    the same child (or a second concurrent child for the same
    parent-shaped role), and no OrganizationalHierarchyOverlapPolicy

  severity: error
  description: This organizational relationship overlaps with an existing one that is not permitted to coexist.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: ORGANIZATIONAL_CYCLE_FORBIDDEN
  meaning: >-

  severity: error

  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

  meaning: >-
```
